中新社上海11月4日电 (记者 许婧 郑莹莹)在华访问的奥地利总理克里斯蒂安·施: China News Service, Shanghai, November 4 (Reporters Xu Jing and Zheng Yingying) Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker, who is visiting China, along with high-level representatives of the Austrian federal government and business delegations, visited Tongji University on the 4th. He gave a keynote speech to Tongji teachers and students, and attended the 100th anniversary of Professor Hans List’s teaching at Tongji University, hoping for a bright future for both countries. Stockel said that day that the cooperation between Tongji University and Austria proves that truly mutually beneficial and win-win cooperation is inseparable from sharing knowledge, co-educating talents, and jointly promoting scientific and technological innovation and progress. Looking to the future, Austria will further deepen mutually beneficial cooperation with China and achieve common development. Tongji University is an important bridge connecting Austria and China. We sincerely look forward to continuing this successful cooperation in the future and jointly creating a better future.
中新社上海11月6日电(记者 肖玉笛)正在上海举行的第九届中国国际进口博览会期间: China News Service, Shanghai, November 6 (Reporter Xiao Yudi) During the 9th China International Import Expo being held in Shanghai, the issue of global economic rebalancing has attracted attention. Participants believed that countries should strengthen trade exchanges, deepen industrial coordination, promote green transformation and inclusive development, and respond to global economic challenges through open cooperation. Mondher Mimouni, Director of the Market Development Department of the International Trade Center, said at the 9th Hongqiao International Economic Forum that global economic rebalancing should center on common growth and inclusive development. China's expansion of imports and platforms such as the China International Import Expo have created practical opportunities for countries in the global South to carry out trade cooperation.
中新社东京11月12日电(记者 朱晨曦)日本农林水产省12日说，京都府一个家禽农: China News Service, Tokyo, November 12 (Reporter Zhu Chenxi) Japan's Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries said on the 12th that highly pathogenic avian influenza occurred in a poultry farm in Kyoto Prefecture. This is the first confirmed bird flu outbreak in Japan this season. The bird flu epidemic season in Japan is from autumn and winter to the following spring every year. A communiqué issued by the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries stated that after receiving a report from a poultry farm in Kameoka City, Kyoto Prefecture on the 11th, the relevant departments of Kyoto Prefecture immediately sent personnel to the farm to investigate and conducted a simple test for avian influenza, and the result was positive.
中新社东京11月16日电 (记者 朱晨曦)日本内阁府16日发表的初步统计结果显示: China News Service, Tokyo, November 16 (Reporter Zhu Chenxi) Preliminary statistical results released by the Japanese Cabinet Office on the 16th showed that due to the decline in personal consumption and excluding price changes, Japan's actual gross domestic product (GDP) in the third quarter of 2026 was basically the same month-on-month, shrinking by 0.1% on an annual basis, and has experienced negative growth again since the third quarter of 2025. According to Japan's Kyodo News Agency, personal consumption performance in the third quarter of this year was weak as prices continued to rise and disasters such as heavy rains and typhoons also became drag factors. Data show that domestic demand contributed 0.6 percentage points to Japan's economic growth in the quarter. Personal consumption, which accounts for more than half of Japan's economy, fell by 0.3% month-on-month in the quarter, showing negative growth for two consecutive quarters; corporate equipment investment, another pillar of domestic demand, increased by 1.6% month-on-month.
中新社东京11月20日电(记者 朱晨曦)日本多个民间团体20日向防卫省递交由约4: China News Service, Tokyo, November 20 (Reporter Zhu Chenxi) On the 20th, multiple Japanese civil groups submitted materials signed by about 47,000 Japanese people to the Ministry of Defense, opposing Japan's possession of nuclear-powered submarines and demanding that the government withdraw related plans. This joint signature event was co-sponsored by private institutions and organizations such as the "Japan Atomic Energy Information Office". The signature event statement stated that Japan, as the only country that has suffered atomic bombing, has always claimed its responsibility to promote the abolition of nuclear weapons, and possessing nuclear-powered submarines is tantamount to actively breaking this commitment. The statement stated that it strongly urged the government to withdraw related plans to possess nuclear submarines.
中新社东京11月20日电(记者 朱晨曦)日本总务省20日公布的数据显示，10月日: China News Service, Tokyo, November 20 (Reporter Zhu Chenxi) Data released by Japan's Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications on the 20th showed that Japan's core consumer price index (CPI) excluding fresh food increased by 2.2% year-on-year to 102.9 in October, rising year-on-year for 62 consecutive months. Data show that rising energy prices are an important factor driving upward prices. With the withdrawal of government subsidies, electricity prices increased from a 2.4% year-on-year decrease in September to a year-on-year increase of 1.6% in October. The year-on-year increase in urban gas prices also expanded from 0.2% to 5.3%. Rising energy prices pushed up the overall price increase by 0.2 percentage points.
中新社东京11月6日电 (记者 朱晨曦)日本众议院6日就高市政府推动的食品饮料消: China News Service, Tokyo, November 6 (Reporter Zhu Chenxi) The Japanese House of Representatives voted on the 6th on the food and beverage consumption tax reduction bill promoted by the Gao City Government. Although the bill was passed by the House of Representatives, it was opposed by the opposition parties and some Liberal Democratic Party members due to issues such as unclear financial resources. Former Japanese Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba and other congressmen withdrew before the vote and did not participate in the vote. The bill plans to reduce the food excise tax rate from the current 8% to 1% for two years starting in April 2027.
中新社东京11月9日电 (记者 朱晨曦)据日本共同社9日报道，日本执政党自民党当: China News Service, Tokyo, November 9 (Reporter Zhu Chenxi) According to Japan's Kyodo News Agency reported on the 9th, Japan's ruling Liberal Democratic Party said on the same day that four people including former Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba left the meeting before the vote on the consumption tax reduction bill and did not vote in favor of them. They will be given warnings. This is the first time that a former prime minister in Japan has been punished in this way. On the 6th of this month, the Japanese House of Representatives voted on the consumption tax reduction bill promoted by the Takaichi Sanae government. The bill plans to reduce the food excise tax rate from the current 8% to 1% for two years starting in April 2027.
中新社伦敦11月10日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)英国国防部10日宣布投入9000万英: China News Service, London, November 10 (Reporter Ouyang Kaiyu) The British Ministry of Defense announced on the 10th that it will invest 90 million pounds to purchase a batch of new unmanned submarines, detection sensors and supporting artificial intelligence monitoring systems, which will be used by the Navy to protect submarine optical cables and energy pipelines in the North Atlantic waters, and to conduct underwater target searches. The project is called "Atlantic Network" and is part of the first phase of the British Army's "Atlantic Fortress" plan. This autonomous system network can be deployed in coordination with the British manned ships, relying on artificial intelligence technology to integrate underwater collection data, automatically generate sea area situation information, push early warning signals to anti-submarine warships and nuclear submarines in advance, and make up for the monitoring blind spots of traditional maritime patrols. The relevant procurement framework agreement has been signed with local British companies.
中新社伦敦11月10日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)英国央行负责货币政策的副行长克莱尔·: China News Service, London, November 10 (Reporter Ouyang Kaiyu) Claire Lombardelli, deputy governor of the Bank of England for monetary policy, said at a central bank meeting on the 10th that the continued risk of British inflation is emerging. Without clear evidence of cooling inflation, there is a high probability that interest rates will need to be raised again in the short term. Lombardelli was a member of the majority at last week's monetary policy meeting, with 8 votes in favor and 1 vote against raising interest rates to 4%. She said that there is a possibility of raising interest rates in the monetary policy meetings to be held in the near future. Each meeting will be dynamically evaluated based on the latest data. The situation in the Middle East, prices and labor market performance will all affect her voting tendency. She focused on analyzing the British labor market, saying that the market vitality is weak, and the pace of corporate recruitment and personnel turnover has slowed down simultaneously.
中新社伦敦11月12日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)英国官方最新公布数据显示，英国第三季: China News Service, London, November 12 (Reporter Ouyang Kaiyu) The latest official data released by the United Kingdom shows that the British economy continued its recovery trend in the third quarter, with a stronger growth rate, hitting the highest level since the first quarter of 2024. It withstood multiple external pressures such as geopolitical conflicts and rising energy prices, and its economic resilience exceeded market expectations. Data released by the British Office for National Statistics on the 12th stated that the British gross domestic product (GDP) increased by 0.7% in the third quarter of 2026 from the previous quarter, which was significantly faster than the 0.5% growth rate in the second quarter, and the year-on-year growth rate rebounded to 1.9%. This round of economic recovery is mainly driven by the service industry, and artificial intelligence-related investment has become a core growth highlight. Statistics show that digital service industries such as computer programming and technology consulting have contributed important growth momentum, computer manufacturing output has increased significantly, and the upstream and downstream of the artificial intelligence industry chain have continued to exert force, driving the overall steady expansion of the British service industry.
中新社伦敦11月14日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)英国苏格兰格拉斯哥一栋公寓楼13日发: China News Service, London, November 14 (Reporter Ouyang Kaiyu) A fire caused by arson broke out in an apartment building in Glasgow, Scotland, on the 13th. A total of 15 residents were sent to the hospital for treatment. The local police have characterized the fire as intentional and launched a special investigation. According to a report from the Scottish Fire and Rescue Department on the 14th, the fire broke out on the evening of the 13th at a four-storey residential apartment building on Copeland Road in Ibrox, Glasgow. The fire initially appeared on the ground floor of the building. After receiving the alarm, the rescue department urgently dispatched fire trucks to the scene for disposal.
中新社伦敦11月16日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)当地时间11月16日，英国首相伯纳姆: China News Service, London, November 16 (Reporter Ouyang Kaiyu) On November 16, local time, British Prime Minister Burnham gave a public speech in London, clearly evaluating the effectiveness of "Brexit" for the first time, bluntly saying that the implementation of "Brexit" in the UK over the years has done more harm than good. Based on multiple differences such as historical diplomatic traditions, immigration control, and financial burdens, British society has always maintained a cautious attitude towards EU integration. In 2016, the United Kingdom held a referendum and passed the "Brexit" option by a narrow vote. After many successive governments’ back-and-forth negotiations, the UK finally officially completed the “Brexit” process in 2020, ending decades of EU membership.
中新社伦敦11月17日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)当地时间11月17日，英国政府宣布实: China News Service, London, November 17 (Reporter Ouyang Kaiyu) On November 17, local time, the British government announced the implementation of a new round of sanctions, taking restrictive measures against a number of Israeli entities involved in settlement construction in the West Bank, in order to safeguard the prospects of advancing the "two-state solution" between Palestine and Israel. The sanctions list includes eight Israeli construction and real estate companies engaged in settlement development and construction. The sanctions include asset freezes and qualification restrictions on company leaders. The companies involved have long been building settlement houses in relevant areas of the West Bank. At the same time, the Israeli organization "Tzav 9", which has long obstructed the delivery of humanitarian aid to the Gaza Strip, is also included in the scope of sanctions. The announcement of the British sanctions comes just before the tender deadline for the E1 settlement project in the West Bank.
中新社伦敦11月17日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)英国国防部17日对外公布称，英国将推: China News Service, London, November 17 (Reporter Ouyang Kaiyu) The British Ministry of Defense announced on the 17th that the United Kingdom will launch a winter air defense assistance plan totaling 240 million pounds to deliver a large amount of air defense equipment to Ukraine to strengthen Ukraine's defense capabilities. Affected by the conflict between Russia and Ukraine, Ukraine's winter airspace security and infrastructure protection are facing continued pressure, and there is a periodic gap in the supply of air defense equipment. The British assistance is part of the winter defense support measures. According to the British report, the entire package of assistance includes more than a thousand short-range air defense missiles and their launchers, as well as more than ten sets of air defense radars.
中新社伦敦11月18日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)英国官方18日公布的数据显示，英国1: London, November 18th (Xinhua News Agency) – Official data released by the UK on November 18th shows that the UK's Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose by 3.6% year-on-year in October, a slight increase from September's 3.5% rise, marking the highest inflation rate in a year. In terms of core price performance, core inflation, which excludes volatile categories such as energy, food, tobacco, and alcohol, remained at 2.8%. The inflation rate in the service sector, which reflects price trends in the real economy, remained stable at 3.7%. Both of these key indicators remained steady, showing no upward trend. The UK Office for National Statistics analyzed that higher fuel prices and the early increase in tobacco taxes this year were the main drivers of the overall rise in inflation in October. At the same time, fierce competition among UK retailers and supermarkets has kept the rise in consumer prices in check.
中新社伦敦11月20日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)英国内政部20日宣布，英国政府持续推: London, November 20 (Xinhua) – The UK Home Office announced on November 20 that the British government is continuing to push forward with reforms to the asylum system. It has once again closed several temporary hotels used to house asylum seekers, further alleviating the strain on local community public services and reducing the financial costs of asylum accommodation. According to official data, since this summer, the UK has closed eight new asylum accommodation hotels, bringing the total number of closures this year to 52. Currently, there are approximately 140 asylum hotels still in use in the UK, a significant reduction from the peak of 400 in 2023. The number of asylum seekers accommodated in hotels has decreased by over 70% from its historical peak, marking a significant reduction in the scale of accommodation.
中新社伦敦11月21日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)当地时间11月21日，英国国防大臣斯: London, November 21 (Xinhua) – On November 21 local time, British Defense Secretary John Healey visited Kyiv, the capital of Ukraine, where he met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Defense Minister Rustem Umerov. The discussions focused on defense industry collaboration and winter defense support, with the aim of advancing arrangements for the production of Ukraine’s domestically developed attack drones in the UK and further strengthening the wartime equipment supply chain between the two countries. The British Ministry of Defense announced on the same day that this was Streeter's second visit to Ukraine since taking office. In response to Ukraine's current air defense challenges, the United Kingdom recently announced a new round of military aid to Ukraine totaling £500 million, with a focus on bolstering air defense, drones, electronic warfare, and other equipment to help Ukraine counter the threat of winter airstrikes. At the same time, the UK reaffirmed its long-term commitment to supporting Ukraine, stating that it will maintain an annual military investment of £3 billion to provide stable defense support to Ukraine.
中新社伦敦11月21日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)英国肯辛顿宫21日消息称，英国凯特王: London, November 21 (Xinhua) – Kensington Palace announced on November 21 that Catherine, Princess of Wales, will publicly share her journey through cancer diagnosis, treatment, and self-healing in a new documentary. For the first time, she will offer an in-depth analysis of how a serious illness profoundly changes one’s body, mind, and perspective on life. This 30-minute personal documentary, titled "Healing," will premiere on November 29 and represents Kate's "most comprehensive and personal" account of her experience following her battle with cancer. In the video clip released by Kensington Palace, Kate candidly admitted that the changes brought about by cancer go far beyond the physical level. “Cancer does change a person. It changes your body, it changes your physiology, but the change that comes with the diagnosis has a deeper, more internal impact.”
中新社伦敦11月23日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)国际足联当地时间23日召开线上特别代: China News Service, London, November 23 (Reporter Ouyang Kaiyu) FIFA held a special online conference on the 23rd local time to officially confirm that England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland will jointly host the 2035 Women's World Cup. This is the first time that the UK has hosted a World Cup in nearly 70 years since it hosted the Men's Football World Cup in 1966. During this 2035 Women's World Cup bidding cycle, the joint plan of England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland was the only valid bid proposal in the world, and was successfully approved by the FIFA Congress. According to the bid plan, the 2035 Women's World Cup in England will adopt a new competition format with 48 teams participating, with the entire process lasting 39 days and a total of 104 games.
中新社伦敦11月24日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)英国诺福克警方24日通报，两名男子涉: China News Service, London, November 24 (Reporter Ouyang Kaiyu) Norfolk Police in the United Kingdom reported on the 24th that two men were arrested on suspicion of illegally trespassing at Anmer Hall, the country residence of Prince William and Princess Kate at Sandringham Manor, with the intention of stealing. They are still in custody and the case is under investigation. At nearly 18:00 on the evening of the 23rd local time, the police received a report of suspicious activities around Anmo Hall. The police immediately deployed police dogs, drones and police helicopters to search Sandringham Manor and captured two men. Police confirmed that no one was in Anmer Hall at the time of the incident.
中新社伦敦11月25日电(记者 欧阳开宇)英国知名平价连锁零售商一镑店(Poun: London, November 25 (Xinhua) – Poundland, a well-known British discount chain retailer, officially entered into administration on November 25 local time. As the controlling shareholder failed to find a suitable buyer to take over, approximately 11,000 jobs at this prominent discount retailer are now at risk. Poundland is an iconic British discount supermarket chain with approximately 600 stores and multiple distribution centers across the UK, offering low-priced everyday essentials to the public. The initiation of the administration process coincides with the eve of the peak Christmas shopping season, sparking concerns within British society regarding employment and the future of the brick-and-mortar retail sector. The controlling shareholder, Gordon Brothers Group, had previously engaged in negotiations with several potential buyers, but no agreement was reached on any of the proposed bailout acquisition plans.
中新社伦敦11月25日电(记者 欧阳开宇)英国首相伯纳姆近日因允许社交媒体网红在: London, November 25 (Xinhua) – British Prime Minister Keir Starmer has recently faced sharp criticism from the opposition parties for allowing social media influencers to film videos at 10 Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence. In his response to Parliament on the 25th, he stated that the content of the video in question was inappropriate and had been taken down. However, he would not apologize for engaging with social media influencers and using social media platforms to convey messages to young people. Since taking office as Prime Minister in July this year, Burnham has proactively adjusted the government's external communication methods. He has frequently invited social media influencers and content creators to film at 10 Downing Street, hoping to bypass traditional media and directly reach younger audiences. He had previously stated publicly that traditional media no longer dominates public opinion as it once did, and that embracing social media influencers is an appropriate choice for the current media landscape.
中新社伦敦11月2日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)当地时间11月2日，英国探险家卡尔·布: China News Service, London, November 2 (Reporter Ouyang Kaiyu) On November 2, local time, British explorer Carl Bushby returned to his hometown of Hull, officially ending his 28-year global walking expedition, bringing an end to this ultra-long journey. Bushby set off from Chile in 1998 and adhered to the principle of zero-motorized travel throughout the journey, relying only on walking and wading across water to advance the journey, with a total mileage of 31,000 miles. Reuters reported that the journey spanned South America, North America, Asia and Europe. He walked through jungles, deserts and polar ice sheets, walked across the ice of the Bering Strait, and crossed the Caspian Sea and the English Channel successively, completing his transcontinental and cross-border journey by pure human means. The 57-year-old Bushby once served in the British Airborne Corps. He originally planned to complete the entire process in ten years, but was significantly delayed due to various emergencies.
中新社伦敦11月2日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)最新数据显示，英国制造业在四季度开端迎: China News Service, London, November 2 (Reporter Ouyang Kaiyu) The latest data shows that the British manufacturing industry has begun to usher in a significant recovery in the fourth quarter, with output growth reaching its best level in more than two years. Order demand at home and abroad has improved simultaneously, but input costs have risen rapidly and inflation concerns have resurfaced, which has strengthened the market's expectations of the Bank of England raising interest rates. The S&P Global Manufacturing Purchasing Managers Index (PMI) released on November 2 confirms this trend. The UK manufacturing PMI rose to 52.8 in October, higher than 51.9 in September; the output sub-index rose to 53.6, the highest since September 2024. The growth of new orders has accelerated, new business has driven production expansion, and corporate confidence has also improved significantly.
中新社伦敦11月2日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)英国内政部2日正式启动“刀具无处遁形”: China News Service, London, November 2 (Reporter Ouyang Kaiyu) The British Home Office officially launched the "Knife Nowhere" special campaign on the 2nd, focusing on areas with high knife crime incidences such as Westminster and Croydon in London. It was also launched simultaneously in Birmingham, becoming an important measure for the British government to maintain community safety. In recent years, the problem of knife crime has continued to plague British urban governance. Although official statistics show that the overall incidence of knife crime in London and other key areas has generally declined in the past two years, the deep social damage caused by knife violence has not subsided. British media said that frequent stabbing cases not only caused a large number of casualties and caused irreversible long-term trauma to the families of the victims, but also seriously weakened the public's sense of security when traveling, and impacted the city's nighttime economy and the normal order of the streets.
中新社伦敦11月5日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)当地时间11月5日，英国央行宣布加息2: China News Service, London, November 5 (Reporter Ouyang Kaiyu) On November 5, local time, the Bank of England announced an interest rate hike of 25 basis points, with the benchmark interest rate raised from 3.75% to 4%. This is the first time the bank has raised interest rates in more than three years since August 2023. This resolution was passed by the Bank of England's Monetary Policy Committee with 8 votes in favor and 1 vote against. The only dissenting member advocated a larger increase in interest rates. The Bank of England clearly issued a follow-up signal, saying that if the current geopolitical conflict between the United States and Iran continues and the pressure on energy prices does not recede, the United Kingdom will most likely usher in a new round of interest rate hikes.
中新社伦敦11月9日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)英国最大水务企业泰晤士水务9日宣布启动: China News Service, London, November 9 (Reporter Ouyang Kaiyu) Thames Water, the UK's largest water company, announced on the 9th the launch of a new round of priority debt financing arrangements. The first phase plans to implement 600 million pounds (approximately 5.374 billion yuan) of new loans, extending the company's available liquidity support cycle to the autumn of 2027, in order to gain time for restructuring and cope with the long-lasting financial crisis. According to this financing plan, Thames Water has obtained permission from its creditors to ensure the continued advancement of basic water investment projects such as pipe network reconstruction and sewage treatment. Thames Water currently carries about 20 billion pounds (approximately 179.1 billion yuan) of debt. As an important public utility enterprise serving London and southeastern England, it has been plagued by high debt for a long time in recent years. Coupled with problems such as insufficient investment in infrastructure and illegal discharge of sewage, it has frequently been subject to regulatory penalties and operational pressure has continued to increase.
中新社加德满都11月19日电 (记者 崔楠)尼泊尔警方中央调查局发言人19日证实: Kathmandu, November 19 (Xinhua) – A spokesperson for the Central Investigation Bureau of the Nepal Police confirmed on November 19 that the Kathmandu District Court had approved the continued detention of six individuals, including two former Ministers of Labor, for a period of four days. The six individuals were arrested on November 18 for their alleged involvement in a case concerning the unlawful collection of fees from workers heading to Malaysia. According to the police report, the six individuals include Sher Bahadur Kunwar and Rameshwor Rai Yadav, both former ministers of Nepal's Ministry of Labor, Employment and Social Security, as well as four former senior officials from the Ministry of Labor. According to the police, the six individuals are suspected of being involved in approving the remittance of illegally collected funds from migrant workers to Malaysia, with the total amount remitted being approximately 1.69 billion Nepalese rupees.
中新社加德满都11月25日电 (记者 崔楠)在尼泊尔南部奇特旺试种的中国杂交水稻: China News Service, Kathmandu, November 25 (Reporter Cui Nan) The Chinese hybrid rice trial planted in Chitwan in southern Nepal ushered in a bumper harvest on the 25th. The yield per mu of the demonstration field was more than twice the average yield per mu of local varieties. On the same day, the hybrid rice harvesting and yield release ceremony was held at the China-Nepal Southern Agricultural Science and Technology Park Demonstration Field. Wang Qian, the expert team leader of the China (Chongqing) Assistance to Nepal Agricultural Technology Project and a senior agronomist at the Chongqing Academy of Agricultural Sciences, announced on the spot that the Chinese hybrid rice grown in demonstration fields this season produced an average of 6.86 tons of rice per hectare, equivalent to a yield of 457.3 kilograms per mu. According to the project team, the average yield of local rice varieties is about 200 kilograms per mu.
中新社加德满都11月25日电 (记者 崔楠)据尼泊尔国家通讯社25日报道，受今年: China News Service, Kathmandu, November 25 (Reporter Cui Nan) According to a report by the Nepalese National News Agency on the 25th, Bidar Town in Nuwakot County, Nepal, which was seriously affected by this year's "August 26" mudslide disaster, recently began to provide housing rental subsidies to 970 disaster-stricken families. Bidar town mayor Rajan Shrestha said the subsidy will be paid directly to the bank accounts of affected families. At present, 1,786 local households have been determined to be eligible for subsidies, and relevant verification work is still in progress. According to the Nepal government's relief package, disaster-stricken families can receive housing rental subsidies for at least 6 months.
中新社北京10月28日电 (陶思阅)中国在线旅游平台去哪儿10月28日发布的数据: China News Service, Beijing, October 28 (Tao Siyue) Data released by China's online travel platform Qunar on October 28 shows that so far that month, the search volume for keywords such as "autumn vacation", "parent-child" and "autumn appreciation" on the platform has increased by 2.2 times month-on-month, the popularity of family-friendly travel products has doubled month-on-month, and the number of hotel bookings for November has increased by 50% year-on-year. Autumn vacations for primary and secondary schools in Zhejiang, Sichuan, Jiangsu, Guangdong, Fujian and other places are starting one after another. Data from the above-mentioned platform shows that the mainstream of travel is to study in big cities and to pursue autumn in small cities. Driven by the demand for research, hotel bookings in Beijing increased 1.3 times year-on-year in November, and hotel bookings in a number of provincial capital cities also showed a high growth trend. At the same time, tourism popularity in county towns tripled year-on-year, and autumn viewing destinations such as Jiuzhaigou Valley in Sichuan, Yixian County in Anhui Province, and Wuyuan in Jiangxi Province are highly popular. Yang Han, a researcher at the Qunar Big Data Research Institute, analyzed that this year’s autumn vacation has evolved into a month-long new peak season for parent-child travel. With suitable temperature conditions, autumn scenery at the best viewing period, and peak-shifting advantages, consumption has been effectively driven.
中新社北京10月28日电 马德里消息：西班牙首都马德里以南的托莱多附近28日发生: China News Service, Beijing, October 28th Madrid News: A train collision occurred near Toledo, south of the Spanish capital Madrid, on the 28th. Spanish media reported that the accident caused two carriages of a train to derail and fall, killing at least 50 people. Based on information from Spanish national television, El Pais, El País and other media, two trains collided near Toledo on the morning of the 28th local time. 中新社北京10月29日电 (记者 孙自法)德国总统施泰因迈尔10月29日在北京访: China News Service, Beijing, October 29 (Reporter Sun Zifa) German President Steinmeier visited the Chinese Academy of Sciences in Beijing on October 29 and was invited to visit the Institute of Atmospheric Physics (Institute of Atmospheric Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences). 中新社北京10月29日电 (记者 阮煜琳)中国自然资源部29日消息，当日，在亚美: China News Service, Beijing, October 29 (Reporter Ruan Yulin) China's Ministry of Natural Resources reported on the 29th that at the "Restoration Day" event of the 17th Conference of the Parties (COP17) of the Convention on Biological Diversity held in Yerevan, Armenia, the United Nations Environment Program officially announced that due to China's outstanding achievements in marine ecological protection and restoration, the "China Blue Bay Renovation Action" was awarded the United Nations "World Ecological Restoration Flagship Project" in 2026. The "China Blue Bay Remediation Action" is organized and implemented under the leadership of the Ministry of Natural Resources and the Ministry of Finance. This is the second national ecological protection and restoration action to be awarded the flagship project after the "China Landscape Project" was awarded the first batch of flagship projects in the world in 2022. China has become the first country to be awarded the flagship project twice with national actions. The "World Ecological Restoration Flagship Project" is jointly launched by the United Nations Environment Program and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations. It is an important global action under the framework of the United Nations Decade of Ecosystem Restoration and aims to select representative, demonstrative and influential large-scale ecosystem restoration actions around the world. Ecological restoration actions in Colombia, Ethiopia, Italy, the United States and other countries were also awarded as flagship projects this time.
中新社北京10月29日电 题：历史学者：所谓“台湾近代化源于日据时期”论调罔顾史: China News Service, Beijing, October 29th: Title: Historian: The so-called "Taiwan's modernization originated from the Japanese occupation period" ignores historical facts. From the 22nd year of Kangxi (1683) when the Qing Dynasty unified Taiwan, to the 21st year of Guangxu (1895) when Taiwan was forced to be ceded to Japan, the Qing Dynasty managed and developed Taiwan for 212 years. In Li Xizhu's view, during this historical period, Taiwan and the mainland truly merged into an indivisible community with a shared future.

中新社北京10月30日电 (记者 郭超凯)记者30日从中国公安部获悉，中国联合印: China News Service, Beijing, October 30 (Reporter Guo Chaokai) The reporter learned from the Ministry of Public Security of China on the 30th that China, Indonesia and Malaysia jointly cracked a large-scale transnational drug production and trafficking case and seized about 1.2 tons of drugs. 中新社北京11月10日电 (记者 孙自法)记者10日从中国科学院近代物理研究所获: China News Service, Beijing, November 10 (Reporter Sun Zifa) The reporter learned from the Institute of Modern Physics of the Chinese Academy of Sciences on the 10th that the joint team of the Institute of Modern Physics and the Guangdong Provincial Laboratory of Advanced Energy Science and Technology spent nearly ten years on continuous research and successfully developed the world's first liquid-free helium-niobium-tri-tin thin film radio frequency superconducting electron accelerator, and achieved stable beam loading. This important research and development achievement based on the main breakthrough direction of building the next generation radio frequency superconducting technology system, niobium and tritin, and realizing deep intersection of accelerators in multiple fields, was recently selected into the "Top Ten Progress of China's Surface Technology in 2026" by the Surface Engineering Branch of the Chinese Mechanical Engineering Society. According to the research team, niobium tritin can increase the operating temperature of superconducting cavities, help accelerators get rid of dependence on liquid helium, and revolutionize the operating mode of superconducting linear accelerators. It is a cutting-edge research hotspot in the field of radio frequency superconductivity. This technological achievement belongs to the deep intersection of accelerator physics, superconducting materials and surface engineering. The research team carried out systematic research through key scientific and engineering problems, revealed the relevant internal mechanisms, broke through a series of key processes, and developed the world's first liquid-free helium niobium three-tin thin film radio frequency superconducting electron accelerator, and achieved stable beam loading, thus building a systematic technical system from basic mechanism, process equipment to prototype beam testing.
中新社北京11月10日电 中国国家市场监督管理总局10日公布，中国牵头制定的光栅: China News Service, Beijing, November 10th China's State Administration for Market Regulation announced on the 10th that the international standard for raster scanning laser displays led by China was officially released by the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC). The standard is jointly developed by Chinese experts as project leaders and experts from Belgium, the United States, Japan and other countries. Raster scanning is one of the main technical routes for laser display. Common products include micro laser projectors, AR/VR displays (augmented reality displays and virtual reality displays), etc. Raster scanning is like using a very thin "laser paintbrush" to draw on the screen: through a small mirror that swings quickly, the laser beam is controlled to move up, down, left, and right to scan out the complete picture.

中新社北京11月23日电 (刘梦青)中国足球协会23日在北京发布《红图计划》。该: Beijing, November 23 (Xinhua) – The Chinese Football Association (CFA) unveiled the "Red Blueprint Plan" in Beijing on November 23. This plan serves as the overarching framework for soccer technical development established by the Chinese Football Association and also functions as a guiding technical document for China's youth soccer initiatives. The "Red Blueprint Plan" directly addresses the long-standing issues in Chinese youth soccer, such as insufficient uniformity in training philosophies, inadequate continuity in development pathways, inconsistent terminology between training and matches, and relatively fragmented evaluation standards. The plan was spearheaded by Chris Van Puyvelde, Technical Director of the Chinese Football Association. The main text is divided into four sections: Theory, Practice, Technological Support, and Promotion and Planning. It focuses on answering three fundamental questions: "What kind of players should be developed?", "What pathways should be used for their development?", and "What methods should be employed for matches?"

Looking at specific month-on-month data, personal consumption expenditures, which account for about 70% of the U.S. economy, increased by 3.8%; non-residential fixed asset investment, which reflects corporate investment, increased by 12.7%; residential fixed asset investment decreased by 3.3%; government consumption expenditures and investments increased by 5.3%; exports of goods and services decreased by 5.7%, and imports increased by 19.7%. Calculated in terms of contribution, personal consumption expenditures drove the economic growth in the quarter by 2.52 percentage points; non-residential fixed asset investment drove the economic growth in the quarter by 1.78 percentage points; government consumption expenditure and investment drove the economic growth in the quarter by 0.9 percentage points; private inventory investment drove the economic growth in the quarter by 1.61 percentage points; net exports dragged down the economic growth in the quarter by 3.32 percentage points.

中新社华盛顿11月6日电 美国劳工部6日发布数据显示，美国10月非农就业岗位增加: China News Service, Washington, November 6: Data released by the U.S. Department of Labor on the 6th showed that the number of non-farm jobs in the United States increased by 165,000 in October, and the unemployment rate was 4.1%. 中新社华盛顿11月7日电 (记者 沙晗汀)上海芭蕾舞团原创芭蕾舞剧《梁山伯与祝英: China News Service, Washington, November 7 (Reporter Sha Hanting) The Shanghai Ballet's original ballet "Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai" was performed at the Arts Center of George Mason University in Virginia, USA, on the evening of the 7th local time. 中新社南京11月12日电 (记者 朱晓颖)江苏省暨南京市各界人士140余人12日: China News Service, Nanjing, November 12 (Reporter Zhu Xiaoying) More than 140 people from all walks of life in Jiangsu Province and Nanjing City held a visit ceremony at the Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum in Nanjing on the 12th to commemorate the 160th anniversary of the birth of Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 中新社南昌11月7日电 (记者 李韵涵 华山)今年是东京审判开庭80周年。7日，: China News Service, Nanchang, November 7 (Reporter Li Yunhan Huashan) This year marks the 80th anniversary of the opening of the Tokyo Trial. 中新社台北11月25日电 据台湾气象部门消息，台湾东南部海域25日16时47分发: China News Service, Taipei, November 25. 中新社台北11月26日电 台湾积体电路制造股份有限公司(台积电)将于当地时间12: China News Service, Taipei, November 26th Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. 中新社台北11月3日电 台湾10月制造业采购经理人指数(PMI)扩张放缓引发关注: China News Service, Taipei, November 3 (Xinhua) The slowdown in the expansion of Taiwan's manufacturing purchasing managers' index (PMI) in October has caused concern. 中新社台南11月20日电 (记者 路梅)“河南洛阳以什么花闻名？”在20日开幕的: China News Service, Tainan, November 20 (Reporter Lu Mei) "What flower is Luoyang, Henan, famous for?" 中新社合肥11月20日电(记者 张俊)以“智联世界：共绘发展合作新图景”为主题的: China News Service, Hefei, November 20 (Reporter Zhang Jun) The 2026 "See China, Listen to the World" forum with the theme of "Intelligent Connected World: Drawing a New Picture of Development and Cooperation" opened in Hefei, Anhui Province on the 20th. Guests from many countries held a dialogue around the global sharing and cooperation of artificial intelligence. Liu Haixing, director of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, said that China believes that world prosperity and stability are fundamentally inconsistent with the poor becoming poorer and the weak becoming weaker. Digital intelligence technology should be an international public good that benefits all mankind. The future of artificial intelligence should not be about the welfare of a few countries and a few people. Countries in the Global South should not and cannot become isolated islands left out by artificial intelligence. Artificial intelligence should be a boon that benefits people all over the world. 中新社合肥11月8日电 (记者 张俊)中国首款可互联中性原子量子计算机“乾阵”原: China News Service, Hefei, November 8 (Reporter Zhang Jun) China's first interconnectable neutral atom quantum computer "Qianzhen" prototype was released in Hefei, Anhui Province on the 8th. Neutral atom quantum computing is one of the current mainstream technical routes for quantum computing. This technical route uses "optical tweezers" arrays to trap neutral atoms to construct qubits. It has the characteristics of strong scalability, high computational fidelity, and easy multi-machine collaborative interconnection. It is an important direction for realizing universal quantum computing. The prototype of "Qianzhen" was developed by Hefei Qianyuan Quantum Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Qianyuan Quantum"). According to Li Gang, professor at the Institute of Optoelectronics of Shanxi University and chairman of Qianyuan Quantum, the "Qianzhen" prototype incorporated interconnection technology from the beginning of its architecture design and is China's first neutral atom quantum computer prototype with multi-machine interconnection capabilities.
中新社吉隆坡11月24日电 (记者 刘育英)马来西亚数字部部长戈宾德·辛格·德奥: China News Service, Kuala Lumpur, November 24 (Reporter Liu Yuying) Malaysian Digital Minister Gobind Singh Deo stated in the House of Commons on the 24th that the government attaches great importance to the risks that may arise from children's emotional dependence on artificial intelligence (AI) companion applications and interactive chat robots, and is studying relevant protective measures, including providing assistance mechanisms for users who are in emotional distress. Gobind said that given that artificial intelligence technology has been widely used among user groups, including children, it is necessary for the government to formulate corresponding standards and regulatory rules to ensure that users fully understand the potential risks of using AI applications and receive appropriate assistance when needed. According to local media reports, the Malaysian government is studying the feasibility of enforcing crisis management procedures and response mechanisms for artificial intelligence applications, especially in high-risk areas. The government also plans to establish a security incident reporting mechanism so that relevant departments can detect problems in a timely manner and take action to prevent further expansion of risks.

中新社土耳其安塔利亚11月18日电 (记者 陈溯 王高飞)《联合国气候变化框架公: Antalya, Turkey, November 18 (Xinhua News Agency) – The 31st Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP31) is currently underway in Antalya, Turkey. In an exclusive interview with China News Service on November 17th local time, Mirey Atallah, Head of the Adaptation and Resilience Branch of the Climate Change Division at the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP), stated that China's carbon emissions management is undergoing a crucial transition. It is moving from a long-standing focus on intensity-based constraints to gradually establishing a rigid constraint with an absolute emissions cap. Additionally, China has built the world's largest renewable energy system, providing valuable experience for other countries globally. Atallah stated that COP31 is entering a crucial phase of ministerial consultations. The new version of the Global Goal on Adaptation has been referred to ministerial-level discussions, and the parties are converging on certain issues.
中新社土耳其安塔利亚11月23日电 (记者 陈溯)当地时间22日，《联合国气候变: Antalya, Turkey, November 23 (Xinhua) – The 31st Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP31) concluded on November 22, local time, after a two-day extension. However, the conference failed to reach a consensus on a final political decision, meaning it did not produce an overall political outcome that was jointly endorsed by all Parties. The repeatedly revised text and the repeatedly postponed closing plenary session ultimately concluded amid waves of "disappointment" from all parties. The host country, Türkiye, defined this COP as the "COP of Implementation." However, nearly 200 Parties found themselves mired in the "deep waters" of coordination due to conflicting interests. The conference also became the longest "overtime" COP in history, leaving numerous unresolved issues for the next session. Fossil fuels were the most prominent point of contention.
中新社圣保罗11月19日电 巴西农业部19日发布数据显示，2026年巴西农牧业总: China News Service, Sao Paulo, November 19. Data released by the Brazilian Ministry of Agriculture on the 19th showed that the total output value of Brazil's agriculture and animal husbandry in 2026 is expected to reach 1.46 trillion reais, a 2.6% decrease from the historical record set last year. Although the output value of agriculture and animal husbandry has declined due to adverse weather conditions, Brazil's agricultural exports continue to maintain growth momentum. Data show that due to excessive rainfall and periodic drought, the output value of Brazil's planting industry is expected to drop by 3.9% year-on-year this year, and the livestock industry will drop by 0.2%. Among them, the soybean and beef cattle breeding industries performed better, with output values ​​expected to increase by 4.6% and 11.8% respectively.
中新社圣地亚哥11月5日电 (记者 林春茵)由中国人权发展基金会、中国社会科学院: China News Service, Santiago, November 5 (Reporter Lin Chunyin) The "2026 China-Chile Human Rights Seminar" co-sponsored by the China Human Rights Development Foundation, the Institute of Latin American Studies at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences and the University of Chile was held in Santiago, the capital of Chile, on the 4th. More than 60 experts and scholars from China and Chile discussed the protection of the right to development, cooperation in the Global South and common development paths around the theme of "China-Chile exchanges, mutual learning and common development - commemorating the 40th anniversary of the adoption of the Declaration on the Right to Development". On December 4, 1986, the United Nations General Assembly adopted the Declaration on the Right to Development, confirming that the right to development is an inalienable human right. Forty years later, how to promote human rights protection through development and improve people's livelihood and well-being through international cooperation has become the focus of the experts attending the meeting.

中新社奥斯陆11月21日电 (记者 马秀秀)初冬的奥斯陆，寒意已至。位于卡尔约翰: China News Service, Oslo, November 21 (Reporter Ma Xiuxiu) In Oslo in early winter, the chill has arrived. 中新社巴黎11月19日电 （记者 李洋）国际能源署当地时间19日发布《2026年: Paris, November 19 (Xinhua) – The International Energy Agency (IEA) released its World Energy Outlook 2026 report on November 19, local time, warning that the conflict in the Middle East is likely to have a lasting impact on energy markets. 中新社巴黎11月27日电 (记者 李洋)法国官方机构当地时间27日发布的经济数据: Paris, November 27th (Xinhua News Agency) – According to economic data released by French official agencies on November 27th local time, the French economy has been sluggish, with a quarter-on-quarter decline of 0.2% in the third quarter of this year. 中新社布鲁塞尔11月17日电 (记者 德永健)欧盟17日发布欧洲经济秋季展望报告: China News Service, Brussels, November 17 (Reporter Toku Yongjian) The European Union released the European Economic Autumn Outlook Report on the 17th, stating that driven by factors such as a strong rebound in commodity exports, the EU's economic growth in the first three quarters of this year was better than expected. On the same day, the European Commission released the European Economic Autumn Outlook Report as usual. It is expected that the EU and Eurozone economies will grow by 1.4% and 1.2% respectively in 2026, 1.4% and 1.2% respectively in 2027, and 1.5% and 1.3% respectively in 2028. 中新社布鲁塞尔11月24日电 (记者 德永健)欧盟24日依据“欧洲学期”机制发布: China News Service, Brussels, November 24 (Reporter Toku Yongjian) The European Union issued a macroeconomic warning report for member states on the 24th based on the "European Semester" mechanism, identifying Italy, Hungary, Slovakia, Romania and Bulgaria as having risks of economic imbalance, and will conduct in-depth reviews of the five countries in the first half of 2027. This early warning report was released on the same day as the European Commission's "Autumn Semester" report. Since the launch of the "European Semester" mechanism in 2011, the EU has released a package of reports and recommendations every "semester" to supervise and guide the macroeconomic policies of member states and guard against major risks such as sovereign debt crises. The early warning report shows that the European Commission has determined that Italy, Hungary and Slovakia are at risk of economic imbalance, and Romania is at risk of excessive economic imbalance. In-depth reviews will be conducted on the four countries in the first half of 2027.
中新社广州11月22日电 (方伟彬 李宇岳)中国第二艘国产大型邮轮“爱达·花城号: Guangzhou, November 22 (Xinhua) – China's second domestically built large cruise ship, the "AIDA·Huacheng," departed from Guangzhou Nansha International Cruise Homeport on November 22, carrying nearly 4,000 guests on its inaugural 6-day, 5-night commercial voyage. The itinerary includes stops in Hong Kong, China, and Huế, Vietnam. The Nansha Border Inspection Station of the Guangzhou Border Inspection General Station cooperated in implementing the "one ship, one policy" safeguard plan and formulated a special service plan for the clearance of large passenger flows to provide full support. Given the cruise ship's large size, high number of passengers, and complex passenger demographics, Nansha Border Inspection Station coordinated in advance with the terminal, shipping agents, and cruise ship operators to complete the preliminary review of ship and passenger information, and worked with Customs and Maritime Affairs to make thorough preparations for joint inspections. The peak passenger flow occurred at 2:00 p.m. on the day of the maiden voyage, with over a thousand passengers passing through in batches in an orderly manner.
中新社广州11月22日电 (记者 王坚)小鹏汇天22日宣布，其研发的全尺寸全倾转: Guangzhou, November 22 (Xinhua) – XPENG AEROHT announced on November 22 that its full-scale, fully tilt-rotor electric flying car, the A868, recently completed a successful tilt-rotor transition test flight. This achievement marks XPeng Aeroht as the first company in China to successfully complete a tilt-transition flight with a full-scale prototype, signifying China's official entry into the global forefront in this technological field. Unlike a simple takeoff and landing demonstration, a "successful tilt-rotor transition" refers to a flying car's ability to fully transition from a vertical takeoff and landing state to a high-speed level flight state. Since completing its first takeoff and landing test flight in November last year, this flying car has progressed from takeoff and landing verification to the stage of full tilt-rotor and other flight capabilities in just one year.
中新社广州11月24日电 (记者 陈建新)全国人大常委会委员、全国台联会长郑建闽: China News Service, Guangzhou, November 24 (Reporter Chen Jianxin) Zheng Jianmin, member of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and president of the All-China Taiwan Federation, called on Taiwan compatriots in Guangzhou on the 24th to play a greater role in promoting Chinese-style modernization and achieve better development while integrating into the overall development of the motherland. They laid flowers to Ho Chi Minh's statue, donated a bronze statue of Ho Chi Minh, learned about Ho Chi Minh's revolutionary activities in Yunnan, and reviewed the profound historical friendship between Vietnam and China.
中新社曼谷11月10日电 (王茜 李映民)泰国内阁10日批准数据中心监管政策，决: China News Service, Bangkok, November 10 (Wang Qi, Li Yingmin) The Thai Cabinet approved the data center regulatory policy on the 10th and decided to implement seven-level classified management according to the scale of power consumption. Projects of 20 MW and above will face more stringent site selection requirements. Thailand's Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance Enidi said that the government will establish a one-stop service center to coordinate the approval of data center projects. According to Danucha, Secretary-General of Thailand’s National Economic and Social Development Council, data centers will be divided into seven levels according to the scale of power consumption: less than 0.5 MW, 0.5 to 5 MW, 5 to 10 MW, 10 to 20 MW, 20 to 50 MW, 50 to 200 MW and 200 MW and above. Among them, projects below 20 MW can be located in commercial areas, while projects of 20 MW and above must be located in industrial areas.
中新社曼谷11月13日电(李映民 王茜 梁峻祥)为期一个月的泰国湄南河灯光节13: China News Service, Bangkok, November 13 (Li Yingmin, Wang Qian, Liang Junxiang) The month-long Chao Phraya River Light Festival in Thailand kicked off on the evening of the 13th. With the theme of "Light of Imagination", the event uses lighting, color, music and multimedia technology to decorate the historical landmarks and cultural landscapes on both sides of the Chao Phraya River into a light and shadow stage. On the same day, Thailand’s Minister of Tourism and Sports Surasak, other cabinet members, and diplomatic envoys from various countries in Thailand took a boat to experience the light festival activities. According to the Tourism Authority of Thailand, this year is the fifth consecutive year that the event has been held. A total of 19 light display points have been set up, extending from the Rama VIII Bridge to the Rama III Bridge along the Chao Phraya River, covering bridges, temples, museums, historical buildings and riverside attractions.
中新社曼谷11月2日电 (梁峻祥 李映民)泰国旅游与体育部2日公布的统计数据显示: China News Service, Bangkok, November 2 (Liang Junxiang, Li Yingmin) Statistics released by Thailand's Ministry of Tourism and Sports on the 2nd showed that from January to October 2026, Thailand received a total of 25.4643 million foreign tourists, a decrease of 4.59% from the same period last year. Among them, the total number of Chinese tourists reached 4.2444 million, a year-on-year increase of 12.44%. From the perspective of tourist source market, China continues to rank first in Thailand’s source market of foreign tourists. Malaysia ranked second with 3.2265 million passengers, and India, Russia and South Korea ranked third to fifth with 1.9244 million, 1.4143 million and 932,100 passengers respectively.
中新社曼谷11月3日电 (王茜 李映民)泰国总理府副发言人帕达拉斯米3日表示，泰: China News Service, Bangkok, November 3 (Wang Qi, Li Yingmin) Padarasmi, deputy spokesperson of the Prime Minister's Office of Thailand, said on the 3rd that the Thai Cabinet approved the draft amendment to the "Social Security Law" submitted by the Ministry of Labor on the same day, which plans to increase the maximum insurance age for employees stipulated in Article 33 of the "Social Security Law" from 60 to 65 years old to adapt to the aging of the population and changes in the labor market. In addition, child support allowances are planned to continue to be paid for 6 months after insured personnel leave their jobs; compensation for childbirth suspension will be adjusted accordingly to make it consistent with labor protection laws and regulations. For persons with disabilities not caused by work, the compensation rate for loss of income is planned to be increased from the original maximum 50% of wages to a maximum of 70%. In terms of pension security, insured persons who have paid social security contributions for 180 months in total can choose to receive monthly pensions or one-time pension subsidies when they reach the age of 55 or their insured status is terminated.
中新社曼谷11月4日电 (王茜 李映民)泰国总理阿努廷4日在曼谷举行的2026年: China News Service, Bangkok, November 4 (Wang Qi, Li Yingmin) Thai Prime Minister Anutin delivered a keynote speech at the 2026 Thailand Standard Economic Forum held in Bangkok on the 4th, proposing the concept of "reshaping Thailand" and emphasizing that Thailand should be based on existing industries and development foundations, adjust the economic structure, enhance industrial competitiveness, and enhance its ability to respond to global economic, technological and geopolitical changes. Anutin said that "reshaping Thailand" does not mean building from scratch, but adjusting, improving and upgrading existing resources and industries. He believes that enhancing independent capabilities and national resilience is an important direction for Thailand to cope with external uncertainties. Energy, food, defense industry, public administration and other fields need to strengthen their own security capabilities. In terms of economic development, Anutin proposed cultivating new economic growth drivers, focusing on the development of modern agriculture, food technology, defense industry, semiconductors and data centers and other industries, while promoting the reform of laws and regulations and reducing unnecessary administrative approval procedures.
中新社曼谷11月6日电 (王茜 李映民)泰国公共卫生部6日召开2027年雾霾及细: China News Service, Bangkok, November 6 (Wang Qi, Li Yingmin) Thailand's Ministry of Public Health held a 2027 haze and fine particulate matter (PM2.5) prevention and control meeting on the 6th, requiring the strengthening of monitoring and management of 40 high-risk provinces across the country, and the deployment of five medical and health response measures to focus on protecting vulnerable groups of approximately 16 million people. Data from Thailand's Ministry of Public Health shows that from 2024 to 2026, more than 60 provinces across the country have exceeded PM2.5 concentration standards, of which 40 have exceeded the standard of 37.5 micrograms per cubic meter for three consecutive years. The health department will strengthen pollution monitoring in high-risk areas and prepare medical services and emergency preparedness in advance. The five measures proposed at the meeting include strengthening the construction of the medical service system, improving monitoring of high-risk areas, establishing a risk map and information registration system for vulnerable groups, integrating local financial resources, and strengthening coordination and cooperation between central and local health agencies.
中新社曼谷11月8日电 (王茜 李映民)泰国职业安全、职业健康与工作环境促进研究: China News Service, Bangkok, November 8 (Wang Qi, Li Yingmin) Namchai, director of Thailand's Institute for Occupational Safety, Occupational Health and Work Environment Promotion, said on the 8th that climate change has led to rising global temperatures and increasingly unstable weather conditions, posing risks to workers' health and occupational safety. Among them, outdoor workers and workers in high-risk environments face particularly prominent threats. Namchai pointed out that the labor safety risks brought about by climate change mainly include six aspects: extreme high temperatures, ultraviolet radiation, extreme weather, air pollution, vector-borne diseases, and other indirect health and safety risks. Sustained high temperatures may cause workers to suffer from heat stress, heat exhaustion and even heatstroke; long-term exposure to ultraviolet rays may damage skin and eye health. In terms of extreme weather, heavy rains, storms, floods and landslides may affect workplace and commuter road safety and increase the risk of work accidents.
中新社曼谷11月9日电 (梁峻祥 李映民)泰国商务部9日与泰国商会举行会谈，并就: China News Service, Bangkok, November 9 (Liang Junxiang, Li Yingmin) The Thai Ministry of Commerce held talks with the Thai Chamber of Commerce on the 9th and reached a consensus on strengthening political and business cooperation, improving the competitiveness of Thai enterprises, and responding to changes in the global trade environment. The Ministry of Commerce of Thailand announced on the same day that Pompon Nainapa, Permanent Undersecretary of the Ministry of Commerce of Thailand, led the heads of seven departments of the Ministry of Commerce to hold talks with the Thai Chamber of Commerce. Pompon Nainapagon said after the meeting that the two sides will deepen cooperation in four directions, including improving economic competitiveness, maintaining economic security and stability, expanding development opportunities for small and medium-sized enterprises and community enterprises, and promoting government services and trade and investment facilitation. The two parties will cooperate to promote the development of Thailand's economy in the direction of high added value, enhance the competitiveness of local enterprises, and at the same time strengthen the price stability and value-added processing of agricultural products to promote Thailand's role in global food security supply.
中新社杭州11月20日电 国际丝绸组织成立大会20日在浙江杭州举行。中共中央政治: China News Service, Hangzhou, November 20th The founding meeting of the International Silk Organization was held in Hangzhou, Zhejiang on the 20th. 中新社柏林11月11日电 德国中国商会联合毕马威11日在法兰克福发布《2026年: China News Service, Berlin, November 11th: The China Chamber of Commerce in Germany and KPMG released the "2026 Business Environment Survey Report for Chinese Enterprises in Germany" in Frankfurt on the 11th. 中新社柏林11月17日电 德国总统施泰因迈尔17日在柏林会见来访的芬兰总统斯图布: China News Service, Berlin, November 17. German President Steinmeier met with visiting Finnish President Stubb in Berlin on the 17th. 中新社柏林11月23日电 当地时间11月23日，德国总理弗里德里希·默茨在柏林会: China News Service, Berlin, November 23. On November 23, local time, German Chancellor Friedrich Mertz met with NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte in Berlin. 中新社柏林11月24日电 德国国防部长皮斯托里乌斯23日在柏林表示，德国未来将在: China News Service, Berlin, November 24. 中新社柏林11月6日电 (记者 马秀秀)德国联邦统计局6日发布的初步数据显示，经: China News Service, Berlin, November 6 (Reporter Ma Xiuxiu) Preliminary data released by the German Federal Statistics Office on the 6th showed that after adjusting for price, seasonal and calendar factors, Germany's industrial output increased by 0.7% month-on-month in September 2026. 中新社柏林11月6日电 德国萨克森-安哈尔特州马格德堡警方6日通报，一架小型飞机: China News Service, Berlin, November 6. 中新社柏林11月9日电 (记者 马秀秀)当地时间9日，德国基督教民主联盟(基民盟: China News Service, Berlin, November 9 (Reporter Ma Xiuxiu) On the 9th local time, the leadership of the German Christian Democratic Union (CDU) officially nominated the 61-year-old Bavarian Parliament Speaker Ilse Aigner to run for the next German president. 中新社比利时布鲁日11月21日电 (记者 德永健)第七届世界海洋生物多样性大会于: Bruges, Belgium, November 21 (Xinhua) – The 7th World Conference on Marine Biodiversity was held from November 17 to 20 in Bruges, a city in northwestern Belgium. The National Institute for South China Sea Studies and Xiamen University sent representatives to attend the conference. 中新社河北雄安11月23日电 (韩冰)2026雄安气象人工智能国际研讨会23日在: China News Service, Xiongan, Hebei, November 23 (Han Bing) The 2026 Xiongan International Symposium on Meteorological Artificial Intelligence opened in Xiongan New District, Hebei on the 23rd. The Earth System Intelligent Research Platform "ZHU·GE" jointly developed by the China Meteorological Administration and the Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory was officially launched at the meeting. "ZHU·GE" is taken from the initials of the English Zone-to-global Holistic Understanding by Generative Earth-system modeling, which means from local to global, from observed facts to scientific understanding. The platform aims to promote artificial intelligence-empowered scientific research (AI4S) in the field of earth sciences. It can quickly transform scientific research ideas into scientific research conclusions that are supported by massive data, can be analyzed, and is verifiable, and helps transform scientific understanding into business capabilities. It is reported that after researchers put forward scientific research goals in natural language, the platform can independently analyze and call literature, data and model resources, independently plan research routes, write programs, conduct experiments, analyze results, and dynamically adjust research directions based on feedback to complete scientific mechanism research, prediction method development and other tasks.
中新社法兰克福11月16日电 (记者 马秀秀)2026年欧元金融周“中国日”活动: China News Service, Frankfurt, November 16 (Reporter Ma Xiuxiu) The "China Day" event of the 2026 Euro Financial Week was held in Frankfurt, Germany on the 16th. 中新社洛杉矶11月12日电 (记者 沙晗汀)第22届中美电影节和中美电视节当地时: China News Service, Los Angeles, November 12 (Reporter Sha Hanting) The 22nd China-US Film Festival and China-US Television Festival held a summit forum and film and television promotion conference in Los Angeles, USA on the 11th local time. 中新社济南11月6日电 (李明芮)“我们要继承和弘扬孙中山精神，将爱国情怀、为民: China News Service, Jinan, November 6 (Li Mingrui) "We must inherit and carry forward Sun Yat-sen's spirit, transform patriotism, original intention for the people, enterprising character, and fighting spirit into practical actions for entrepreneurship, and strive to realize the Chinese dream of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation and Sun Yat-sen's long-cherished wish to 'revitalize China.'" 中新社浙江绍兴11月1日电 (项菁)11月1日，在浙江绍兴举行的2026阳明心学: China News Service, Shaoxing, Zhejiang, November 1st (Xiang Jing) On November 1st, at the 2026 Yangming Mindwork Conference "Integrated Development of Yangming Mindfulness and Low-altitude Economy" held in Shaoxing, Zhejiang Province, Zhou Bingde, niece of Premier Zhou Enlai and former vice president of China News Service, fondly recalled Premier Zhou who had an aerospace dream, and encouraged future generations to continue moving forward towards the stars and the sea. 中新社海牙10月27日电 荷兰当局27日通报，进入今年秋冬季后，荷兰两家农场接连: China News Service, The Hague, October 27th. The Dutch authorities reported on the 27th that after the autumn and winter of this year, bird flu outbreaks broke out in two farms in the Netherlands, and more than 45,000 poultry were culled. According to an announcement issued by the Dutch Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality on the same day, one of the farms involved was located in Westerkwartier, a city in the northern province of Groningen. In order to curb the spread of the epidemic, the authorities culled approximately 45,000 poultry on the farm. The announcement stated that there are no other farms within 1 km and 3 km of the farm involved, and there are 21 farms within 10 km of the farm involved. From now on, these farms are not allowed to transport poultry, eggs, feed, poultry manure, garbage, etc. Another farm involved is located in Edam-Volendam, North Holland Province. In order to curb the spread of the epidemic, the authorities culled about 150 poultry on the farm.
中新社深圳11月11日电 (记者 蔡敏婕)2026年亚太经合组织(APEC)领导: China News Service, Shenzhen, November 11 (Reporter Cai Minjie) The 2026 Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Leaders' Meeting Week News Center was opened in Shenzhen, Guangdong on the 11th. 中新社深圳11月14日电 (记者 程景伟)亚太经合组织(APEC)第三十三次领导: China News Service, Shenzhen, November 14 (Reporter Cheng Jingwei) The 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Leaders' Informal Meeting will be held in Shenzhen, Guangdong from November 18 to 19, 2026. 中新社深圳11月18日电 (记者 李京泽 张焕迪)俄罗斯总统普京18日在亚太经合: China News Service, Shenzhen, November 18 (Reporter Li Jingze and Zhang Huandi) Russian President Vladimir Putin said in his speech at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Business Leaders Summit on the 18th that the Asia-Pacific region has become the global economic center and APEC is an important platform for all parties to find solutions in multiple fields. 中新社深圳11月18日电 (记者 王宗汉 国璇)加拿大总理卡尼18日在亚太经合组: China News Service, Shenzhen, November 18 (Reporters Wang Zonghan and Guoxuan) Canadian Prime Minister Carney expressed at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Business Leaders Summit on the 18th that he hopes to strengthen cooperation with China in various fields and focus on areas that can bring the greatest practical results to the people of Canada and China.
