Xi Jinping pointed out that this year marks the 30th anniversary of the establishment of the China-Russia strategic partnership of coordination and the 25th anniversary of the signing of the China-Russia Treaty of Good Neighborliness, Friendship and Cooperation. Sino-Russian relations are both "steady as a mountain despite rain or shine" and "we should take a long-term view", providing more stability and certainty to a world intertwined with changes, and setting a model for a new model of major-country relations featuring equal treatment, mutual respect, trustworthiness and win-win cooperation. Facing the future, both sides should always maintain their pioneering and enterprising vitality and constantly explore the potential and connotation of China-Russia relations in the new era; remain down-to-earth and deepen all-round cooperation between the two countries; firmly shoulder the responsibilities and responsibilities that major powers should have, and lead and promote world multipolarity and the democratization of international relations.
中新社深圳11月19日电 (记者 刘文文)11月的深圳，入夜微凉，盐田港灯火如昼: China News Service, Shenzhen, November 19 (Reporter Liu Wenwen) In Shenzhen in November, the night is slightly cool, and the lights of Yantian Port are like daylight, making it a busy scene. As one of the largest single container terminals in the world, there are 53 direct routes to Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) member economies every week. China’s new energy vehicles and cameras went to sea from here, and Malaysian durians and Chilean cherries came across the sea. In the Asia-Pacific region, similar voyages happen every moment.
中新社深圳11月19日电 (记者 郑嘉伟)《2026年亚太经合组织工商领导人峰会: China News Service, Shenzhen, November 19 (Reporter Zheng Jiawei) The "2026 APEC Business Leaders Summit Shenzhen Initiative" (referred to as the "Shenzhen Initiative") was released on the 18th. This is the first time in the 30 years since the establishment of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Business Leaders Summit that an outcome document has been released in the form of an initiative. Many interviewed experts and scholars said that the Shenzhen Initiative builds consensus among the business community for open cooperation in the Asia-Pacific region and injects certainty into a turbulent world. "The Shenzhen Initiative incorporates the results of the APEC Business Advisory Council's discussions throughout the year, puts forward suggestions from the business community to the APEC Leaders' Informal Meeting, and lists actions that the business community is willing to participate in." Liao Fan, director of the Institute of World Economics and Politics at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, said in an interview with a reporter from China News Service that this reflects the Asia-Pacific business community's willingness to actively build consensus and actively seek certainty in a global environment of intertwined events.
中新社深圳11月19日电 亚太经合组织互联互通蓝图19日发布。蓝图强调，互联互通: China News Service, Shenzhen, November 19th The APEC Connectivity Blueprint was released on the 19th. The blueprint emphasizes that connectivity promotes the flow of goods, services, capital and people in the region, helps to close economic ties and promote long-term economic growth; guided by the 2040 APEC Putrajaya Vision, we will move towards building an open, dynamic, strong and peaceful Asia-Pacific community and achieve common prosperity for the people of the Asia-Pacific and future generations. In terms of "hard connectivity", the blueprint states that the goal is to encourage economies to build, maintain and upgrade high-quality infrastructure through innovation and application of modern technologies to improve the level of hard connectivity. Strengthen land, sea and air connectivity, and improve regional connectivity through transportation connections.
中新社深圳11月20日电 (记者 国璇)11月18日至19日，亚太经合组织(AP: China News Service, Shenzhen, November 20 (Reporter Guoxuan) From November 18 to 19, the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Leaders’ Informal Meeting was held in Shenzhen. Leaders of many APEC member economies have praised Shenzhen's development achievements on different occasions and look forward to more "Shenzhen miracles" to appear and inject more certainty into Asia-Pacific regional cooperation. "In less than 50 years, Shenzhen has grown from a border town to a megacity with a population of about 18 million." Canadian Prime Minister Carney believes that Shenzhen represents one of the greatest changes of this era.
中新社深圳11月20日电 (记者 李京泽 国璇)17日至20日，中国国家主席习近: China News Service, Shenzhen, November 20 (Reporters Li Jingze and Guoxuan) From the 17th to the 20th, Chinese President Xi Jinping met intensively in Shenzhen with leaders of APEC member economies who came to China to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Leaders’ Informal Meeting. During the meeting, leaders of many APEC member economies made it clear that they firmly adhere to the one-China principle. On November 19, Xi Jinping met with US President Trump. Since the beginning of this year, from Beijing to Washington to Shenzhen, the heads of state of China and the United States have interacted face-to-face three times.
中新社深圳11月8日电 作为东道主服务中外记者采访报道的重要数字基础设施——20: China News Service, Shenzhen, November 8th. The 2026 Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Leaders' Meeting Week News Center website (press.apec2026.cn), an important digital infrastructure that serves as the host to serve Chinese and foreign journalists in reporting, went online on the 8th. From November 18th to 19th, the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting will be held in Shenzhen. The last Senior Officials' Meeting of APEC's "Year of China", the APEC Business Advisory Council meeting, the APEC Business Leaders' Summit and other supporting activities will also be held during the 2026 APEC Leaders' Meeting Week. The News Center website is a content service platform built by the host China to serve domestic and foreign journalists in reporting and reporting. It has opened sections such as news releases, media announcements, important events, service information, and Shenzhen overview to provide participating Chinese and foreign media with full-process services from information acquisition to interview guarantee.
中新社湖北荆门11月1日电 (记者 孙自法)中国社会科学院考古研究所所长施劲松研: China News Service, Jingmen, Hubei Province, November 1 (Reporter Sun Zifa) Researcher Shi Jinsong, director of the Institute of Archeology of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, said on November 1 that archaeological discoveries and research have shown that prehistoric water control is a distinctive feature of the Yangtze River civilization. The utilization and management of water resources reflect the survival wisdom of prehistoric ancestors in adapting to and transforming nature. It also profoundly affects the evolution of early settlement forms, the development of social organizations and even the process of regional civilization. An academic seminar on prehistoric water control and traceability of the Yangtze River civilization, co-sponsored by the Institute of Archeology of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, the Neolithic Archeology Professional Committee of the Chinese Archaeological Society, and the Hubei Provincial Institute of Cultural Relics and Archeology, was held that day in Jingmen, Hubei, known as the gateway to Jingchu. Shi Jinsong attended the meeting and delivered a speech. He said that since ancient times, human beings have lived by water. From digging canals for farming, digging trenches and dams, developing agriculture, to flood control and transportation across river basins, the ability to manage, control and use water resources has always been closely linked to social development. Archaeological research also shows that prehistoric water control is by no means a simple production technology activity. It is related to resource allocation, social organization, public power, technological inheritance, belief systems, etc. In-depth study of the remains of prehistoric water control can explore the early social structure and the origin and development model of civilization from multiple dimensions.
中新社澳大利亚伍伦贡11月13日电(记者 薄雯雯)“达尔富拉姆事件”88周年纪念: China News Service, Wollongong, Australia, November 13 (Reporter Bo Wenwen) A commemoration event for the 88th anniversary of the "Darfuram Incident" was held on the 13th in Port Kembla, Wollongong, Australia, to commemorate the strike launched by local dock workers in 1938 to oppose Japanese militarism and support China's war of resistance. The event was co-organized by the Australian Maritime Union and the Australian South Coast Union. Representatives from all walks of life in China and Australia observed a minute's silence in front of the "Darfuram Incident" monument for the victims of World War II and laid wreaths at the monument. Wang Chunsheng, Acting Consul General of the Chinese Consulate General in Sydney, said in his speech that he paid tribute to the dock workers’ spirit of crossing borders and helping each other.
中新社甘肃酒泉11月24日电 (记者 马帅莎)11月24日，神舟二十四号乘组名单: China News Service, Jiuquan, Gansu, November 24 (Reporter Ma Shuaisha) On November 24, the crew list of Shenzhou 24 was announced. The flight crew consists of aerospace pilot Tang Hongbo, aerospace flight engineer Wu Yi, and payload expert Muhammad Qishan Ali. Tang Hongbo serves as the commander. This is the first flight crew of China's manned space program to include foreign astronauts. The three astronauts met with Chinese and foreign media reporters at the Wentian Pavilion of the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center that day.
中新社甘肃酒泉11月24日电 (记者 马帅莎)神舟二十四号载人飞行任务新闻发布会: China News Service, Jiuquan, Gansu Province, November 24 (Reporter Ma Shuaisha) The press conference for the Shenzhou 24 manned mission was held at the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center on the 24th. The reporter learned from the meeting that Chinese astronaut Zhu Yangzhu will carry out a one-year on-orbit test mission. According to reports, the Shenzhou 24 manned spacecraft aims to be launched at 08:18 on November 25, Beijing time. The flight crew consists of Tang Hongbo, Wu Yi and Pakistani astronaut Muhammad Qishan Ali. According to the mission plan, during this crew rotation, Pakistani astronaut Mohammad Zishan Ali mainly performed short-term joint missions, and then returned with astronauts Zhang Zhiyuan and Li Jiaying on the Shenzhou 23 manned spacecraft.
中新社福州11月27日电 (叶秋云)于27日在福州市举行的第七届海峡两岸(福州): China News Service, Fuzhou, November 27 (Ye Qiuyun) At the theme day event of the 7th Cross-Strait (Fuzhou) Employee Innovation, Entrepreneurship and Creation Competition held in Fuzhou City on the 27th, a large AI model for employee innovation project guidance and innovation achievement transformation for employees on both sides of the strait was officially launched. The organizer said that this large AI model will promote the "golden ideas" of employees on both sides of the Taiwan Strait to become evaluable, tradable, and protected innovative assets. This competition was launched in May and has attracted more than 600 project teams from both sides of the Taiwan Strait to sign up. It consists of a four-skill creation group for employees, an employment and entrepreneurship group for employees, and a cross-strait integration cooperation group. After multiple rounds of competition, a total of 6 gold awards, 11 silver awards, and 19 bronze awards were awarded, covering key areas such as artificial intelligence, new energy, new materials, and smart medical care.
中新社福建泉州11月15日电 题：蟳埔女习俗：从渔村日常到花漾美学。秋冬时节的福: China News Service, Quanzhou, Fujian, November 15th. Title: Customs of women in Xianpu: From daily life in the fishing village to flowery aesthetics. In autumn and winter, Quanzhou, Fujian Province is still full of flowers. In the ancient streets and alleys, many tourists wear hairpins and walk and take photos. Looking from a distance, it looks like a "flowing garden". This kind of headdress called "Hairpin Flower Wai" is an important part of the customs of women in Xunpu in southern Fujian, China. It is mainly spread in Xunpu, Jinqi, Houpu, Dongmei and other communities in Donghai Street, Fengze District, Quanzhou City.
中新社秘鲁钱凯11月20日电 题：探访秘鲁钱凯港：跨越太平洋的发展新机遇。202: China News Service, Chancay, Peru, November 20. Title: Visiting the Port of Chancay, Peru: New Development Opportunities Across the Pacific. Two years later, APEC time came to Shenzhen, China. As a landmark project of Asia-Pacific connectivity, what changes have taken place in Chancai Port?
中新社约翰内斯堡11月15日电 非洲疾控中心15日发布公告称，刚果(金)的本迪布: China News Service, Johannesburg, November 15th: The Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention announced on the 15th that the Bundibugyo Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has lasted for six months, with more than 11,000 reported cases and more than 5,400 deaths. The epidemic is still spreading, with 400 to 500 new cases every week. The announcement stated that in this round of epidemic, children accounted for more than a quarter of the confirmed cases and one-third of the deaths. Among children under 5 years old diagnosed with Ebola virus, the death rate is as high as 70%.
中新社约翰内斯堡11月18日电 (记者 孙翔)南非统计局18日公布的数据显示，南: Johannesburg, November 18 (Xinhua) – Data released by Statistics South Africa on November 18 showed that South Africa's Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose by 5.2% year-on-year in October, up from 4.5% in September, reaching its highest level since May 2024 and meeting market expectations. The data shows that in October, prices in the transportation category in South Africa rose by 15.2% year-on-year, driving the overall inflation rate up by 2.1 percentage points; prices in the housing and utilities category rose by 5.2% year-on-year, driving it up by 1.3 percentage points; and prices in the insurance and financial services category rose by 5.3% year-on-year, driving it up by 0.6 percentage points. Patrick Kelly, Chief Director of Price Statistics at Statistics South Africa, stated that rising fuel prices are the main reason for the increase in transportation inflation. In October, South Africa's fuel prices rose by 11.8% month-on-month and by 42.9% year-on-year, an increase of 15 percentage points from September, reaching the highest level since August 2022.
中新社约翰内斯堡11月20日电 (记者 孙翔)南非警察局20日公布的犯罪统计数据: Johannesburg, November 20 (Xinhua) – According to crime statistics released by the South African Police Service on November 20 (Reporter: Sun Xiang), a total of 5,590 murders occurred in South Africa from July to September this year, averaging about 60 people murdered each day. Of these, nearly 3,000 took place in public spaces. At a press conference held on the same day, South Africa's Acting Minister of Police, Feroz Cachalia, stated that violent crime in South Africa is generally on a downward trend, with 204 fewer cases compared to the 5,794 cases reported during the same period last year. This quarter saw a significant decline in armed robbery cases. Specifically, car hijackings decreased by 16.8% year-on-year, and truck hijackings decreased by 27.9%.
中新社约翰内斯堡11月23日电 亚的斯亚贝巴消息：非洲多国领导人和公共卫生专家2: China News Service, Johannesburg, November 23. News from Addis Ababa: Leaders and public health experts from many African countries attended the Fifth International Conference on Public Health in Africa (CPHIA2026) in Addis Ababa, the capital of Ethiopia, on the 23rd. The theme of the conference is "Health Security and Autonomy in Africa: Transforming from Health Dependence and Vulnerability to Autonomous Control and Resilience Building." African Union Commission Chairman Youssef said at the opening ceremony that Africa cannot continue to rely on external sources for the medicines, vaccines and basic medical supplies needed to protect people's health. He called on African countries to increase domestic investment in health, develop local pharmaceutical manufacturing, strengthen disease surveillance and public health emergency response capabilities, and ensure that relevant policy commitments are implemented.
中新社约翰内斯堡11月25日电(记者 孙翔)南非西开普省高等法院25日作出裁决，: Johannesburg, November 25 (Xinhua) – The High Court of South Africa, Western Cape Division, ruled on November 25 to set aside an independent investigation report that had previously found President Cyril Ramaphosa suspected of violating the Constitution and engaging in misconduct. The court also declared the impeachment proceedings initiated by the National Assembly based on that report to be unlawful and therefore nullified them. The court ruled on the same day that the independent investigation panel had misapplied the standards for reviewing evidence and exceeded its statutory investigative authority, and therefore its report had no legal effect. In 2022, an independent panel of three legal experts recommended that Parliament initiate an impeachment inquiry into Ramaphosa's handling of a theft at his Phala Phala game farm in South Africa's Limpopo province. The case involved the theft of hundreds of thousands of dollars in cash hidden in a sofa.
中新社约翰内斯堡11月27日电 坎帕拉消息：乌干达病毒研究所27日发表声明，当地: Johannesburg, November 27th – China News Service reports from Kampala: The Uganda Virus Research Institute issued a statement on November 27th, announcing the commencement of Africa's first clinical trial for a messenger RNA (mRNA) vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus. The trial has been reviewed and approved by local regulatory authorities. This trial in Uganda will be the first to evaluate the safety and immunogenicity of the vaccine in children aged 1 year and older. The trial plans to recruit approximately 224 healthy volunteers aged 1 to 65 years.
中新社约翰内斯堡11月4日电 (记者 孙翔)南非4日举行地方政府选举。南非独立选: China News Service, Johannesburg, November 4 (Reporter Sun Xiang) South Africa will hold local government elections on the 4th. The Independent Electoral Commission of South Africa stated that afternoon that as of 17:00 local time, approximately 12 million voters across the country had completed voting. Sai Mamabolo, Chief Electoral Officer of the Independent Electoral Commission of South Africa, said at a press conference held at the Johannesburg Election Results Operation Center that day that as of 17:00, about 12 million voters had completed voting, with Gauteng Province having the largest number of voters, about 3 million people. Voting for this election begins at 7 a.m. and ends at 9 p.m.
中新社约翰内斯堡11月8日电 (记者 孙翔)南非独立选举委员会8日晚公布2026: China News Service, Johannesburg, November 8 (Reporter Sun Xiang) The Independent Electoral Commission of South Africa announced the results of the 2026 local government election on the evening of the 8th. The voting rate of the ruling party African National Congress (ANC) dropped from 45.59% in 2021 to 30.76%, but it still ranked first. More than half of the town councils in South Africa have "hung councils", which means that no political party obtains an absolute majority of seats, and the formation of local government faces multi-party negotiations. According to the announced results, the Democratic Alliance ranked second with 24.64% of the vote, and the National Spear Party ranked third with 9.76%. The ANC won an absolute majority in 53 towns and the Democratic Alliance won an absolute majority in 12 towns.
中新社纽约11月16日电 美国马萨诸塞州联邦地区法院一名法官16日作出裁决，认定: China News Service, New York, November 16. A judge of the Federal District Court of Massachusetts in the United States ruled on the 16th that the new regulations previously announced by the Department of Homeland Security that limited the stay period of international students, exchange visitors, and foreign media representatives in the United States violated the Administrative Procedure Act and decided to revoke them. Judge F. Dennis Saylor of the Federal District Court of Massachusetts wrote in the ruling that the new regulations announced by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security in July intend to cancel the original "status period framework" for F, J and I non-immigrant visa holders and instead set a fixed period of stay. The decision-making process under this provision is arbitrary and lacks reasonable consideration, constituting an abuse of discretion. If implemented, the new rules will further weaken the United States' ability to attract international talent, disrupt education programs, and increase the burden on schools.
中新社纽约11月19日电 (记者 王帆)美国人工智能公司Anthropic当地时: China News Service, New York, November 19 (Reporter Wang Fan) Anthropic, an American artificial intelligence company, was listed on the Nasdaq Stock Exchange in New York on the 19th local time. Its initial public offering (IPO) total financing exceeded US$81.3 billion, setting a record for the largest IPO financing scale in the history of the U.S. stock market. On that day, Anthropic was listed at an issue price of US$83 per share. After including private placements and other shares, the fully diluted market value was approximately US$1.5 trillion. When the market officially opened, the stock was trading at $111.50, and the company's market value once reached about $2 trillion. As of the close, the stock was trading at $97.17, an increase of 17.07%.
中新社莫斯科10月30日电 俄罗斯人权事务专员兰特拉托娃30日表示，赫尔松地区奥: China News Service, Moscow, October 30 (Xinhua) Russian Human Rights Commissioner Lentratova said on the 30th that the humanitarian rescue operation in Oreshki, Kherson region has been completed. Representatives of Russia and Ukraine both stated that the ceasefire system in the direction of Kherson has been observed by both parties. Lantratova posted a video on social media that day saying that the convoy evacuated from Oreshki had arrived in Armeniask in the Crimea region. The convoys are currently being divided into groups and waiting for buses according to their destinations. Those who decide to go to Ukraine will go to Ukraine, and those who decide to go to Russia will be escorted by the Russian side to the temporary resettlement point in Russia.
中新社莫斯科11月11日电 俄罗斯、美国、乌克兰三方会谈代表11日在阿拉伯联合酋: China News Service, Moscow, November 11. Representatives of Russia, the United States, and Ukraine concluded their talks in Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, on the 11th. Medinsky, Assistant to the Russian President and Head of the Russian Delegation, told the media after the talks that the European security system was the core topic of the talks, and all parties had reached consensus on certain aspects. Russia and Ukraine have reached agreement on a new round of large-scale prisoner exchanges. Medinsky said that the European security system is the core topic of this meeting. With the participation of the United States, Russia and Ukraine exchanged their respective positions and reached consensus in some aspects, but not in some aspects.
中新社莫斯科11月11日电 俄罗斯外交部11日发布消息说，俄罗斯驻美国大使亚历山: China News Service, Moscow, November 11th: The Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on the 11th that Russian Ambassador to the United States Alexander Dalchiev died suddenly on the same day at the age of 66. The Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that Dalchiyev is an outstanding diplomat, experienced leader and a good mentor. An accomplished diplomatic professional and expert on U.S. affairs, Dalchiev has long worked in one of the most critical areas of Russian foreign policy. Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Zakharova posted on social media platforms that day that Dalchiyev died in Moscow due to chronic illness, and the date and location of his farewell ceremony will be announced later.
中新社莫斯科11月11日电 俄罗斯总统普京11日在克里姆林宫主持召开集体安全条约: China News Service, Moscow, November 11th: Russian President Vladimir Putin chaired a meeting of the Collective Security Council of the Collective Security Treaty Organization (CSTO) at the Kremlin on the 11th. The meeting adopted a series of documents including the CSTO Collective Security Council Declaration and decided to cancel Armenia’s voting rights in the organization. Belarusian President Lukashenko, Kazakhstan President Tokayev, Tajikistan President Emomali Rahmon and Kyrgyzstan President Zhaparov attended the meeting. The declaration stated that the development of cooperation within the framework of the CSTO is a diplomatic priority of the organization and joint measures will be taken to further strengthen the collective security system.
中新社莫斯科11月12日电 俄罗斯总统助理乌沙科夫12日晚表示，俄美双方同意继续: China News Service, Moscow, November 12. Russian Presidential Assistant Ushakov said on the evening of the 12th that Russia and the United States agreed to continue to advance negotiations on the Ukraine issue. Russia supports the United States’ proposal to establish a new European security architecture and hopes that Europe will support this work. Ushakov said that Russian President Vladimir Putin met with U.S. presidential envoy Witkov and President Trump's son-in-law Kushner at the Kremlin that day. The dialogue and exchanges between the two parties were "rich in content, constructive, candid and effective." Ushakov said that the United States supports Putin’s proposal to extend the model of humanitarian operations successfully carried out in Oreshki to Konstantinovka on the “line of contact” between Russia and Ukraine.
中新社莫斯科11月17日电 俄罗斯国防部17日通报说，一架安-12军用运输机在西: China News Service, Moscow, November 17. The Russian Ministry of Defense reported on the 17th that an An-12 military transport plane crashed in Kemerovo Oblast in southwestern Siberia, killing all 19 people on board. The TASS news agency quoted information from the Russian Ministry of Defense as reporting that an An-12 military transport aircraft crashed in Kemerovo Oblast while performing a routine flight that day. There were 19 people on board, including the crew, and all died. The Russian Defense Ministry said that a preliminary investigation showed that the cause of the crash was a technical failure.
中新社莫斯科11月1日电 俄罗斯联邦安全局11月1日通报表示，在对美国提供的关于: China News Service, Moscow, November 1. The Russian Federal Security Service reported on November 1 that it had arrested a Russian minor during the investigation of intelligence provided by the United States about a possible terrorist attack at the Tsaritsyno Manor in Moscow. The Russian Federal Security Service announced on its official website that it, in conjunction with the Russian National Guard, the Ministry of Internal Affairs and the Investigative Committee, investigated intelligence provided by U.S. law enforcement agencies about a possible terrorist attack in the Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve in Moscow. To ensure public safety, scheduled cultural events in the museum reserve have been canceled and security precautions have been stepped up in the surrounding area. According to reports, a Russian minor male was arrested in related operations.
中新社莫斯科11月1日电(记者 田冰)11月1日，俄罗斯央行官方网站显示1美元兑: China News Service, Moscow, November 1 (Reporter Tian Bing) On November 1, the official website of the Russian Central Bank showed that 1 US dollar was exchanged for 80.56 rubles, which was basically the same as the exchange rate at the end of October. In October, the ruble exchange rate strengthened significantly, successfully stabilizing at the 80 mark from 85.71. The market's focus has also shifted from "what is the logic of the continued strength of the ruble" to "what variables exist in the future." On October 30, the official exchange rate set by the Russian Central Bank was: 1 US dollar to 80.68 rubles, 1 euro to 89.82 rubles, and 1 yuan to 12.08 rubles.
中新社莫斯科11月24日电 俄罗斯总统普京24日主持召开能源发展战略和环境安全委: China News Service, Moscow, November 24. When Russian President Vladimir Putin chaired a meeting of the Energy Development Strategy and Environmental Security Committee on the 24th, he stated that Russia will definitely respond to Ukraine’s attack on Russia’s energy infrastructure. Putin said that despite the challenging geopolitical situation, Russian fuel and energy companies still occupy a leading position in the global energy market. The main goal of the domestic fuel market is to ensure stable supply and ensure fuel supply for urban and rural areas, people, enterprises, etc. The stability of the domestic fuel market has been maintained through measures such as increasing fuel production, increasing reserves, restructuring supply chains, and adjusting import and export mechanisms.
中新社莫斯科11月25日电 第七届中俄媒体论坛25日在莫斯科举行。与会嘉宾表示，: Moscow, November 25, China News Service – The 7th China–Russia Media Forum was held in Moscow on November 25. The guests at the forum stated that, under the strategic guidance of the leaders of both countries, China-Russia media cooperation has continued to expand and has yielded fruitful results. They emphasized the importance of seizing the opportunity presented by this forum to jointly usher in a new era of China-Russia media cooperation in the digital age. The guests at the forum pointed out that since the beginning of this year, the heads of state of China and Russia have held multiple meetings, reached a consensus on expanding cultural and people-to-people exchanges, and jointly witnessed the signing of several media cooperation agreements. The outcomes of the meetings clearly outlined the joint organization of the China-Russia Media Forum, the promotion of exchanges between mainstream media outlets, and the enhancement of joint talent development. These initiatives serve as crucial guidelines for deepening cooperation between Chinese and Russian media.
中新社莫斯科11月3日电 俄罗斯国防部3日通报说，俄军当天凌晨对乌克兰多个能源基: China News Service, Moscow, November 3rd: The Russian Ministry of Defense reported on the 3rd that the Russian military carried out intensive attacks on multiple energy infrastructure targets in Ukraine in the early morning of that day, hitting 4 power plants and 2 substations in Ukraine. The governor of Russia's Yaroslavl region said that an oil refinery in the state was damaged by a Ukrainian drone attack and caught fire. Moscow Mayor Sobyanin posted on social media on the 3rd that from 20:30 on the 2nd to 7:30 on the 3rd local time, 493 Ukrainian drones flew in the direction of Moscow, most of which were destroyed at long distances, and 187 drones were shot down as they approached Moscow. Mikhail Yevlayev, governor of the Yaroslavl region, reported that Russian electronic warfare and air defense forces repelled a large-scale drone attack launched by Ukraine against the oil refinery in the state in the early morning of the same day. A total of 124 drones participated in the attack.
中新社西藏那曲11月21日电 初冬的藏北高原，寒风凛冽，羌塘国家级自然保护区内，: China News Service, Nagqu, Tibet, November 21 – On the Northern Tibetan Plateau in early winter, the biting cold wind blows. Within the Qiangtang National Nature Reserve, rangers are carrying out their usual patrol duties. On November 21, the Forestry and Grassland Bureau of Nagqu City reported that, thanks to an increasingly sophisticated management network and technological tools, the region is creating an "undisturbed" habitat for wild animals such as the Tibetan antelope. Located in the heart of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, Nagqu City has an average elevation of 4,500 meters. It is home to three national-level nature reserves: Changtang, Selincuo, and Maidika Wetland. These reserves provide habitats for Chinese national first-class protected animals such as the Tibetan antelope, wild yak, and black-necked crane. Since the establishment of the Nagqu Administration Bureau of the Changtang National Nature Reserve in 2015, 36 management stations have been set up in the area, forming a protection network comprising rangers, village-level wildlife conservation officers, ecological police officers, and ordinary herders.
中新社郑州11月21日电 (记者 阚力)第十四届中国中部投资贸易博览会(以下简称: Zhengzhou, November 21 (Xinhua News Agency) – The 14th China Central Region Investment and Trade Expo (hereinafter referred to as the "Central Expo") opened on November 21 in Zhengzhou, Henan Province. Government and business leaders from the six provinces of the Central Region gathered to discuss new pathways for the region's rise. Foreign businesspeople who came in groups to seek cooperation opportunities expressed optimism about the Central Region's market. The six central provinces are Shanxi, Anhui, Jiangxi, Henan, Hubei, and Hunan. The central region is an important base for China's grain production, energy and raw materials, modern equipment manufacturing, and high-tech industries, as well as a comprehensive transportation hub. In an on-site interview, Michael Hart, President of the American Chamber of Commerce in China, stated that the Central Region boasts a large population and strong economic strength, offering value in terms of market, manufacturing, and innovation collaboration. It is an excellent location for companies seeking market opportunities.
中新社重庆11月27日电 (钟旖 宋紫月)27日在重庆市举办的空天科技创新与产业: China News Service, Chongqing, November 27 (Zhong Yi, Song Ziyue) At the Aerospace Science and Technology Innovation and Industrial Development Conference held in Chongqing on the 27th, Chongqing University’s Space Solar Power Station Experimental Base was unveiled. This is China’s first space solar power station experimental base. Chongqing University's "Space Energy Wireless Transmission Double Star Project" was simultaneously released, taking a key step towards conducting on-orbit testing of space wireless energy supply technology in real space environments. Space solar energy is regarded as a promising energy development direction in the future. The idea of ​​capturing solar energy in space and then transmitting it back to the ground through wireless means such as microwaves or lasers is a major scientific and technological project being explored at the global forefront. "Currently, space wireless energy transmission is only applied in a few special aerospace scenarios. If we want to build a ground-based power grid and use it in a large-scale system, it will take 10 to 20 years of continuous research.
中新社金边10月30日电 (张安琪 张堰林 杨强)柬埔寨文化艺术部当地时间30日: China News Service, Phnom Penh, October 30 (Zhang Anqi, Zhang Yanlin, Yang Qiang) A press release issued by the Cambodian Ministry of Culture and Art on the 30th local time stated that 18 Khmer cultural relics that had been recovered in London, England, were officially handed over to the Cambodian Embassy in the United Kingdom on the same day, and arrangements will be made to transport them back to the country in the near future. The press release stated that the aforementioned cultural relics were seized by the Art and Antiques Investigation Department of the London Metropolitan Police in November 2025. After expert appraisal, it was confirmed that these cultural relics were unearthed from Cambodia. The Cambodian Ministry of Culture and Arts proposed to relevant parties in September 2026 to return these cultural relics to Cambodia.
中新社金边11月10日电 (杨强 张安琪 张堰林)柬埔寨干拉省克萨干丹县一辆运送: China News Service, Phnom Penh, November 10 (Yang Qiang, Zhang Anqi, Zhang Yanlin) A vehicle transporting students in Kesagandan County, Kandal Province, Cambodia accidentally fell into a pond on the 10th local time. Preliminary information said that the accident killed 5 students and injured 2 others. A notice issued by BELTEI School in Cambodia stated that on the morning of the 10th, 26 students from the school were involved in a traffic accident on their way to school in a socially operated vehicle. Five of the students were killed and two of the 21 surviving students were injured. According to reports, the aforementioned accident occurred along National Highway No. 8 in Kesagandan County, Kandal Province. The vehicle involved deflected to avoid a motorcycle, rolled over and fell into a pond next to the road.
中新社金边11月14日电 题：在柬埔寨金边“法语国家文化村”感受多元文化魅力。1: China News Service, Phnom Penh, November 14th. Title: Feel the charm of multiculturalism at the "Francophone Cultural Village" in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. On November 14, in front of a photo wall that read "A Smile for the French-speaking World", tourists took turns leaving smiles in front of the camera. The originally blank map of Cambodia on the wall was filled with smiling faces. Not far away, the traditional Rwandan drums were beating loud and powerful, the Turkish chef cut into the sizzling grilled meat, the Moroccan chef opened the pointed metal cover, and the stewed chicken was freshly cooked and fragrant. The 20th Francophone Summit will be held in Cambodia from the 15th to 16th of this month.
中新社金边11月15日电(张安琪 张堰林 杨强)第20届法语国家组织峰会当地时间: China News Service, Phnom Penh, November 15th (Zhang Anqi, Zhang Yanlin, Yang Qiang) The 20th Francophonie Summit opened in Phnom Penh, the capital of Cambodia, on the 15th local time. With the theme of "Reinvesting in Peace, Promoting Common Prosperity and Sustainable Stability", the summit was attended by dozens of leaders of various countries and heads of international organizations. Cambodian King Norodom Sihamoni pointed out in his opening speech that Cambodia’s historical experience shows that without peace, prosperity cannot last. It is hoped that the international community will strengthen dialogue and cooperation and jointly safeguard lasting peace.
中新社金边11月16日电 (张堰林 张安琪)柬埔寨国王诺罗敦·西哈莫尼与法国总统: China News Service, Phnom Penh, November 16th (Zhang Yanlin, Zhang Anqi) Cambodian King Norodom Sihamoni and French President Macron jointly cut the ribbon on the completion of the restoration project of the ancient temple of Ximeben on the 16th local time. This thousand-year-old monument is located in Siem Reap Province, Cambodia. After a 14-year joint restoration by Cambodia and France, it is now reopened to domestic and foreign tourists. The ancient temple of Sime Beng is located in the center of Sibalai Lake in Siem Reap Province. It was built in the mid-11th century and is an important historical and cultural heritage of Cambodia. The temple launched a large-scale restoration and reconstruction project in 2012, which was jointly carried out by relevant parties in Cambodia and France. The total investment in the project was US$12 million.
中新社金边11月16日电 (张安琪 张堰林 杨强)第20届法语国家组织峰会当地时: China News Service, Phnom Penh, November 16 (Zhang Anqi, Zhang Yanlin, Yang Qiang) The 20th Francophonie Summit concluded on the 16th local time in Phnom Penh, the capital of Cambodia. The meeting adopted three outcome documents, including the "Phnom Penh Declaration" and the "Phnom Penh Call: Protecting Cultural Heritage." The theme of this summit is "Reinvesting in Peace, Promoting Common Prosperity and Sustainable Stability". All parties participating in the summit jointly discussed international cooperation, multilateralism, sustainable development and other related issues. The Phnom Penh Declaration adopted on the 16th proposed 32 action propositions, covering many fields such as crisis prevention and mediation, digital governance, youth development, cultural heritage protection and response to climate change.
中新社金边11月27日电 (记者 杨强)2026年柬埔寨国际商务与投资论坛当地时: Phnom Penh, November 27 (Xinhua) – The 2026 Cambodia International Business and Investment Forum was held in Phnom Penh on November 27 local time, with Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Manet attending the opening ceremony. Over a thousand businesspeople and investors from China, Malaysia, Singapore, Japan, South Korea, the European Union, and other countries and regions engaged in discussions centered around themes such as "Cambodia's Development, Global Opportunities." In his address, Hun Manet reaffirmed the Cambodian government's commitment to continuously improving the investment environment and opening up the market to attract more domestic and foreign investment. He stated that in the 20 years leading up to the COVID-19 pandemic, Cambodia's economy had experienced sustained rapid growth, transitioning from a planned economy to a market economy. Its industrial structure had also evolved from a single traditional agricultural base to a diversified one, making it an economy capable of accommodating emerging and high-value-added industries.
中新社金边11月3日电 (张堰林 杨强)柬埔寨首相洪玛奈当地时间11月3日表示，: China News Service, Phnom Penh, November 3 (Zhang Yanlin Yang Qiang) Cambodian Prime Minister Hong Manai said on November 3, local time, that Cambodia plans to trial full-time teaching in 200 qualified public primary and secondary schools, extending the daily teaching time from 4 hours to 6 hours, and promote it nationwide in stages to comprehensively improve the quality of basic education in the country. When attending the opening ceremony of the new school building in Kampong Thom Province that day, Hong Manai said that currently about 200 public primary and secondary schools in Cambodia have the conditions to implement the "4 hours + 2 hours" teaching arrangement. The government will use these schools as pilots to gradually expand the scope of implementation and implement the goal of 6 hours of in-school learning per day for 12-year basic education from primary school to high school. He said that the aforementioned teaching model does not require huge expenditures and a large number of modern equipment. It only needs to make full use of existing resources and appropriately extend the teaching time to allow students to learn normally. This move will not only help improve the quality of education and cultivate talents, but also effectively reduce the negative behaviors of teenagers such as racing on the streets in their spare time, reducing the burden on families and society.
中新社金边11月4日电 (张安琪 张堰林 杨强)因燃油资金耗尽导致200余名乘客: China News Service, Phnom Penh, November 4 (Zhang Anqi, Zhang Yanlin, Yang Qiang) The American cruise ship "MV Odyssey" left Cambodia in the early morning of November 4, local time, due to running out of fuel funds and causing more than 200 passengers to be stranded in Cambodia. Officials from Cambodia's Sihanoukville Province Tourism Bureau confirmed that the cruise ship had left the Sihanoukville Autonomous Port after completing fuel replenishment at 0:25 that day. Tang Sochetkresna, director of Cambodia’s Sihanoukville Tourism Bureau, said on the 4th that the cruise ship only carried part of the crew when it left the port, and the rest of the crew had already left the country by plane. It is not yet known where the cruise ship will go next.
中新社阿斯塔纳11月26日电 (记者 单璐)哈萨克斯坦阿拉木图市一处民宅26日凌: China News Service, Astana, November 26 (Reporter Shan Lu) A fire broke out in a house in Almaty, Kazakhstan in the early morning of the 26th, killing five people, including a minor. The Almaty City Emergency Situation Bureau reported that it received an alarm at 3:44 a.m. local time. When the first firefighters arrived at the scene four minutes later, the house was already surrounded by flames. The bureau dispatched a total of about 35 firefighters and 9 firefighting equipment to participate in the firefighting.
中新社阿斯塔纳11月27日电 (记者 单璐)中国驻哈萨克斯坦大使馆26日在阿斯塔: China News Service, Astana, November 27 (Reporter Shan Lu) The Chinese Embassy in Kazakhstan held the 2026 China-Kazakhstan media briefing in Astana on the 26th. During the nearly two-hour exchange, Chinese Ambassador to Kazakhstan Han Chunlin answered questions from reporters from China and Kazakhstan on cooperation between China and Kazakhstan in the fields of industry, transportation, energy, science and technology, and humanities. How to improve the quality and upgrade of China-Kazakhstan industrial cooperation is one of the focuses of Kazakh media reporters. Han Chunlin said that since the beginning of this year, enterprises from the two countries have promoted a number of cooperation projects in the fields of copper smelting, amino acid production, polyethylene production, etc., promoting the expansion of cooperation between the two parties into high value-added fields.
中新社阿斯塔纳11月3日电 2026年中亚经济合作天山论坛2日至3日在哈萨克斯坦: China News Service, Astana, November 3. The 2026 Tianshan Forum on Central Asia Economic Cooperation was held in Almaty, Kazakhstan from the 2nd to the 3rd. With the theme of "Strengthening Resilient Connectivity and Promoting High-Quality Investment in Central Asia", this forum was attended by more than 300 senior government officials, representatives of international organizations, business people and think tank experts from member countries of the Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation Mechanism (CAREC), and exchanges were held on topics such as transportation, trade, energy and digital connectivity. At the opening ceremony, Chinese Finance Minister Lan Fo'an said that over the years, under the framework of the Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation Mechanism and through the joint efforts of member states and development partners, Central Asia's connectivity has accelerated, trade and investment have flourished, and major projects have been continuously implemented, forming a pragmatic, efficient, and deeply integrated cooperation pattern. China is willing to strengthen cooperation with Central Asian countries, vigorously promote the "China-Central Asia Spirit", build a closer China-Central Asia community with a shared future, and support the development of Central Asia into a "golden crossroads" connecting the Eurasian continent.
中新社雅加达11月12日电(记者 李志全)印度尼西亚副总统吉布兰12日向该国人民: China News Service, Jakarta, November 12 (Reporter Li Zhiquan) Indonesian Vice President Jibrand formally submitted his resignation letter to the country's People's Consultative Conference on the 12th. Indonesian People's Consultative Assembly Chairman Muzani said the organization's leadership will hold a meeting to discuss the follow-up to the resignation letter. Gibran had previously expressed his intention to resign to Indonesian President Prabowo. On the 12th, he went to the office of the Chairman of the People's Consultative Conference, met with Muzani, and personally submitted his resignation letter to resign as Vice President.
中新社雅加达11月16日电 (记者 李志全)印度尼西亚总统普拉博沃15日代表印尼: China News Service, Jakarta, November 16 (Reporter Li Zhiquan) On the 15th, on behalf of the Indonesian government and people, Indonesian President Prabowo expressed his apology to Singapore and Malaysia for the impact of cross-border haze on neighboring countries. Prabowo made the above statement at the plenary session of the 49th ASEAN Summit held in Manila, Philippines. Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong and Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar also attended the summit. According to the Indonesian Presidential Palace, Prabowo emphasized the importance of ASEAN unity and cooperation in his speech.
中新社雅加达11月22日电 (记者 李志全)印度尼西亚万丹省西冷县一家糖果厂21: Jakarta, November 22 (Xinhua) – A fire broke out at a candy factory in Serang Regency, Banten Province, Indonesia, on the evening of November 21 (Reporter: Li Zhiquan). According to the latest information from the search and rescue department on November 22, the accident has resulted in three fatalities, four injuries, and dozens of people unaccounted for. Indonesia's National Search and Rescue Agency stated that rescue personnel have entered the fire scene to search several areas within the factory where people are suspected to be trapped, with a focus on the building areas previously engulfed by the fire. So far, rescue workers have found the bodies of three victims, and the whereabouts of 36 others are still being searched for.
中新社雅加达11月2日电 (记者 李志全)东南亚最大经济体印度尼西亚制造业呈现回: China News Service, Jakarta, November 2 (Reporter Li Zhiquan) The manufacturing industry in Indonesia, Southeast Asia's largest economy, is showing a rebound momentum. Data released by S&P Global on the 2nd showed that in October 2026, Indonesia's manufacturing purchasing managers index (PMI) rose to 54.0, the highest level since March 2024, and the manufacturing expansion momentum was the strongest in 31 months. Indonesian Economic Coordinating Minister Airranga said that day that the manufacturing PMI continued to rise, reflecting the market's increased confidence in the Indonesian economy. Indonesian Industry Minister Mohamed Salmuji also believes that this shows that Indonesian industrial operating conditions are improving.
中新社雅加达11月2日电 (记者 李志全)印度尼西亚外国游客接待量持续增长。印尼: China News Service, Jakarta, November 2 (Reporter Li Zhiquan) The number of foreign tourists in Indonesia continues to grow. Data released by the Indonesian Central Bureau of Statistics on the 2nd showed that from January to September 2026, Indonesia received a total of 12.01 million foreign tourists, a year-on-year increase of 5.01%. Aten Hartono, deputy director of the Indonesian Central Bureau of Statistics, said that the scale of this reception hit a new high for the same period since 2020. From the perspective of tourist source markets, Malaysia, Australia and China are the top three sources of foreign tourists to Indonesia.
中新社雅加达11月5日电 (记者 李志全)印度尼西亚中央统计局5日公布的数据显示: China News Service, Jakarta, November 5 (Reporter Li Zhiquan) Data released by Indonesia's Central Bureau of Statistics on the 5th showed that in the third quarter of 2026, Indonesia's gross domestic product (GDP) increased by 5.47% year-on-year, higher than market expectations. The growth rate was higher than the 5.29% in the second quarter and slightly lower than the 5.61% in the first quarter. Compared with the 5.04% growth rate in the third quarter of 2025, economic growth has accelerated in the same period this year. Mohammad Eddie Mahmoud, deputy director of the Indonesian Central Bureau of Statistics, said that the Indonesian economy has maintained growth amid global economic uncertainty.
中新社首尔10月27日电 (记者 金旭)当地时间27日，韩国最高法院以“存在毁灭: China News Service, Seoul, October 27 (Reporter Kim Wook) On the 27th local time, the Supreme Court of South Korea issued an additional arrest warrant for Kim Gun-hee, the wife of former South Korean President Yoon Seok-yue, on the grounds of "the possibility of destroying evidence or absconding." Jin Jianxi's detention period, which was originally scheduled to expire on October 31, will be temporarily extended by two months to the end of this year. Jin Jianxi has been involved in many cases and has been in custody since August 2025. In April 2026, Jin Jianxi was sentenced to 4 years in prison in the second instance for manipulating stock prices, accepting bribes and other crimes.
中新社首尔11月11日电 (记者 金旭)当地时间11日，韩国京畿道城南市盆唐区早: China News Service, Seoul, November 11 (Reporter Jin Xu) On the 11th local time, a bus crash occurred in Bundang District, Seongnam City, Gyeonggi Province, South Korea during the morning rush hour, causing 48 people to be injured to varying degrees. The Chinese Embassy in South Korea stated that no Chinese citizens were injured in the accident. According to the South Korean police and fire department, at around 7:34 that day, a bus driven by a man in his 60s continuously hit 32 vehicles waiting for the signal lights in a section of about 100 to 150 meters, including 4 buses, 1 truck and 27 cars, and finally stopped after hitting the central median of the road. So far, the accident has caused 6 serious injuries and 42 minor injuries, including the bus driver.
中新社首尔11月17日电 (记者 金旭)针对韩国社会近期对利用人工智能(AI)技: China News Service, Seoul, November 17 (Reporter Kim Wook) In response to South Korean society's recent concerns about the use of artificial intelligence (AI) technology to cheat on exams, South Korean President Lee Jae-myung said on the 17th local time that cheating seriously undermines the foundation of fair competition and damages the long-term trust accumulated in society, and is a serious crime. The Korean University Academic Ability Test (ie the College Entrance Examination) will be held on the 19th. Li Zaiming emphasized that cheaters must adhere to the zero-tolerance principle and be dealt with seriously in accordance with the law. He asked relevant government departments to check again whether there are any omissions and make improvements in a timely manner.
中新社首尔11月19日电 (金旭 陈艺玲)韩国大法院(最高法院)当地时间19日就: Seoul, November 19 (Xinhua) – On November 19 local time, the Supreme Court of South Korea issued a ruling in the case involving former Prime Minister Han Duck-soo’s alleged participation in an insurrection. The court found that Han’s actions constituted the crime of participating in a key task of an insurrection. However, it overturned certain convictions from the second-instance ruling and remanded the case to the Seoul High Court for retrial. According to Yonhap News Agency, the Supreme Court held that some of Han Duck-soo's actions were sufficient to constitute the crime of participating in an important task related to insurrection. However, regarding his suggestion to convene a State Council meeting and his attempt to create the appearance that the emergency martial law decree had been reviewed by the State Council, the existing evidence was insufficient to prove that he had the intent to disrupt the constitutional order. Therefore, he was acquitted of these charges. The Supreme Court stated that after the declaration of martial law, Han Duck-soo encouraged members of the State Council to sign relevant documents and discussed measures such as blocking major institutions like the National Assembly and cutting off water and electricity to the media. These actions can be considered as participation in insurrection. In addition, the Supreme Court upheld the guilty verdicts for the crimes of Han Duck-soo forging official documents, violating the Presidential Records Act, and committing perjury, as determined in the second-instance judgment.
中新社首尔11月19日电(记者 金旭)韩国产业通商资源部19日表示，韩国2026: Seoul, November 19 (Xinhua) – The South Korean Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy announced on November 19 that, according to preliminary statistics, South Korea's cumulative export value for 2026 has exceeded $1 trillion (approximately RMB 6.7 trillion), making it the fourth country in the world, after the United States, Germany, and China, to achieve an annual export value surpassing $1 trillion. According to South Korea's Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, since 2024, the growth rate of global trade in products related to artificial intelligence (AI) applications has consistently outpaced the overall growth rate of global trade in goods. Driven by the AI investment boom, South Korea's semiconductor exports surged by 193.1% year-on-year to $396.8 billion from January to October 2026, accounting for 42.7% of total exports. In addition, South Korea's other key industries have also demonstrated strong competitiveness.
中新社首尔11月19日电(金旭 林珺)韩国大法院(最高法院)19日就韩国前总统尹: China News Service, Seoul, November 19 (Kim Wook, Lin Jun) The South Korean Supreme Court (Supreme Court) made a final judgment on the 19th on the case of former South Korean President Yoon Seok-yue's wife Kim Gun-hee being suspected of manipulating stock prices and accepting bribes. She was sentenced to 4 years in prison and fined 50 million won (approximately RMB 250,000). This is the first time that the South Korean Supreme Court has made a ruling on a case related to Kim Gun-hee. Yonhap News Agency reported that this is the first time in South Korea’s constitutional history that a former president’s wife has been sentenced to actual imprisonment for a criminal offense. The Supreme Court of South Korea rejected the protest and appeal of both the "Kim Jianxi Special Inspection Team" and Kim Jianxi on the same day, and upheld the original judgment of the second instance.
中新社香港11月22日电 (记者 刘玥晴)2026年香港特区选举委员会(简称“选: China News Service, Hong Kong, November 22 (Reporter Liu Yueqing) The results of the 2026 Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Election Committee (referred to as the "Election Committee") subsector general election were announced on the evening of the 22nd. According to the results announced by the Registration and Electoral Office, all 723 election committee seats in the 31 subsectors contested by 856 candidates were successfully elected. The Election Committee is an important part of the Hong Kong SAR electoral system and consists of 1,500 people. Its responsibilities include nominating candidates for the SAR Chief Executive election, selecting the Chief Executive designate, nominating candidates for the SAR Legislative Council election, and electing 40 Legislative Council members. Voting for this election will start at 9:00 and end at 18:00 on the 22nd. There will be a total of 5 general polling stations and 2 dedicated polling stations open to registered voters or authorized representatives who are competing for the subsectors to vote.
中新社香港11月22日电 香港特区行政长官李家超22日向2026年香港特区选举委: China News Service, Hong Kong, November 22 (Xinhua) The Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Mr Lee Ka-chiu, congratulated the elected members of the 2026 Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Election Committee (referred to as the "Election Committee") subsector general election on the 22nd. He hopes that all members of the Election Committee will perform their duties upholding the principle of "patriots governing Hong Kong" and contribute to the stable and long-term implementation of "one country, two systems". Li Jiachao pointed out that the Election Committee is composed of 40 sub-sectors and a total of 1,500 people. It is broadly representative and complies with the principle of balanced participation. It shoulders important statutory functions under the principle of improving the electoral system and implementing the principle of "patriots governing Hong Kong". There are 31 subsectors to compete in this election, and a total of 856 validly nominated candidates are competing for 723 seats.
中新社马尼拉10月30日电 (记者 周璟)菲律宾火山地震研究所30日称，将吕宋岛: China News Service, Manila, October 30 (Reporter Zhou Jing) The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology said on the 30th that the alert level of Mayon Volcano in Albay Province, southeastern Luzon Island, was raised from level 2 to level 3, indicating an increase in the tendency of dangerous eruptions. The agency reported that at about 11:53 that day, Mayon Volcano erupted with a moderate intensity explosive eruption. The volcanic ash column rose to about 3,000 meters above the crater and spread to the west-southwest. It is expected that volcanic ash may fall in the surrounding areas. The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology stated that the level 3 alert means that the volcano has entered a new stage of magma eruption, and the risk of dangerous volcanic activities such as lava flows and pyroclastic density flows will increase in the next few days to weeks. The agency recommended that residents within the 6-kilometer permanent danger zone around the Mayon crater immediately evacuate, and reminded the public to guard against pyroclastic flows, lahars and other disasters.
中新社马尼拉11月11日电(记者 周璟)菲律宾大气地球物理天文局11日表示，菲律: China News Service, Manila, November 11 (Reporter Zhou Jing) The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Bureau stated on the 11th that the high temperature index in about 60 areas in the Philippines is expected to reach a high warning level that day, with a local maximum of 41 degrees Celsius. According to the forecast issued by the agency, the high temperature index in Palawan, Eastern Samar, Albay and other places is expected to reach 38 to 41 degrees Celsius. The agency said that a weather station in Iloilo Province in the central Philippines recorded a high temperature index of 42 degrees Celsius on the 10th, reaching the dangerous level. At this level, the body is susceptible to heat cramps and heat exhaustion.
中新社马尼拉11月13日电 (记者 周璟)菲律宾总统府12日表示，政府已做好应对: China News Service, Manila, November 13 (Reporter Zhou Jing) The Philippine Presidential Palace stated on the 12th that the government is ready to respond to cyber attacks against government agencies. Previously, the National Privacy Commission of the Philippines confirmed that it had received reports of cyber attacks and data leaks in at least 10 government departments, and a large amount of corporate and personal privacy data had been leaked. Claire Castro, spokesperson for the Philippine Presidential Palace, said at a press conference that day that hacker attacks on government agency websites have occurred in the past, but related incidents were handled in a timely manner. She stressed that the government was prepared to deal with cyber attacks and website intrusions.
中新社马尼拉11月15日电 应东盟轮值主席国菲律宾总统马科斯邀请，中国国务院总理: China News Service, Manila, November 15. At the invitation of President Marcos of the Philippines, which holds the rotating chair of ASEAN, Chinese Premier Li Qiang arrived at Manila's Ninoy Aquino International Airport on a chartered flight on the evening of November 15 to attend the China-ASEAN Leaders' Meeting. Philippine Finance Minister Wu Shize, Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan, Chinese Ambassador to ASEAN Wang Qing and others greeted him at the airport. However, due to the previous lack of relevant fossil records in China, particularly in South China, this has become one of the key mysteries in human evolution and has attracted considerable attention. 中新网巴黎11月6日电 法国科西嘉岛本周发生严重洪灾，当地政府6日表示，灾情已造: China News Service, Paris, November 6 (Xinhua) Severe flooding occurred in Corsica, France this week. The local government stated on the 6th that the disaster had killed two people. According to French media citing local government sources, a car was swept away by floods in Corsica late at night on the 5th. Rescuers went to the scene of the incident in the early morning of the 6th to rescue the driver and rescued the driver by helicopter. However, the two passengers in the car could not be rescued and were found dead soon after. The road section where the incident occurred is now completely closed to vehicular traffic. Corsica has been hit by severe flooding in recent days, mainly caused by extremely heavy rainfall.

中新网布鲁塞尔11月26日电(记者 德永健)欧盟25日对俄罗斯发起贸易制裁，将俄: Brussels, November 26 (Xinhua) – The European Union imposed trade sanctions on Russia on November 25, targeting 15 Russian entities. According to an announcement issued by the Council of the European Union on the same day, the EU has designated 15 Russian entities as targets of sanctions on the grounds of supporting Russia's military-industrial complex, and has decided to impose stricter export controls on dual-use items and advanced technologies for these entities. At the same time, the EU removed one entity previously sanctioned by the EU from the sanctions list on the grounds of ceasing support for Russia's military-industrial complex, and decided to lift the export controls imposed on this entity. This marks the EU's second round of sanctions against Russia this month.
中新网布鲁塞尔11月27日电(记者 德永健)欧盟统计局26日公布今年三季度欧盟货: China News Service, Brussels, November 27 (Reporter De Yongjian) Eurostat released the EU's import and export data for goods trade in the third quarter of this year on the 26th, showing that the EU's total imports of goods trade in the third quarter of this year were 730 billion euros. China is the largest source of imports for the EU's goods trade. Data show that the EU's total imports of goods trade in the third quarter of this year were 730 billion euros, an increase of 1.7% from the second quarter of this year and an increase of 15.7% from the third quarter of 2025. In terms of major trading partners, China was the EU's largest import source of goods trade in the third quarter of this year, with a total import of 163 billion euros from China, accounting for 22.3% of the EU's total imports of goods trade in the quarter. The United States is the EU's second largest import source of goods trade, with a total import of 100.9 billion euros from the United States, accounting for 13.8% of the EU's total imports of goods trade in the quarter.
中新网布鲁塞尔11月6日电 第十四届中欧论坛5日在布鲁塞尔举行，以“中欧未来50: China News Service, Brussels, November 6. The 14th China-EU Forum was held in Brussels on the 5th. 中新网广州11月24日电 (记者 王坚)据广东省市场监督管理局(知识产权局)24: China News Service, Guangzhou, November 24 (Reporter Wang Jian) ​​According to news from the Guangdong Provincial Administration for Market Regulation (Intellectual Property Office) on the 24th, the "15th Five-Year Plan for the Protection and Application of Intellectual Property in Guangdong Province" (referred to as the "Plan") was recently issued. The "Plan" focuses on cultivating and deploying high-value patents in strategic emerging industries and future industries, and strives to have 580,000 high-value invention patents in the province by 2030. The "Plan" clarifies that by 2030, the comprehensive strength and competitiveness of Guangdong's intellectual property rights will be further enhanced, the legal protection of intellectual property rights will be more comprehensive, intellectual property rights will be more integrated with technology and industry, intellectual property rights protection will be more powerful, the market value of intellectual property rights will be more evident, intellectual property services will be of higher quality, intellectual property exchanges and cooperation will be more in-depth, the intellectual property cultural consciousness of the whole society will be basically formed, and decisive progress will be made in building a higher-level intellectual property strong province. The "Plan" strengthens the corresponding connection with the national intellectual property plan, scientifically sets up the "8+N" indicator system, covering key indicators such as the number of high-value invention patents per 10,000 people, the cumulative number of international patent applications under the Patent Cooperation Treaty, and refines chapter indicators in line with work tasks, taking into account provincial conditions and international conditions, total volume and structure, macro contributions and micro feelings, and jointly points to better serving Guangdong's innovative development.

中新网广州11月6日电 (郭军 胡海焱)由国铁广州局深圳工程建设指挥部建设、中铁: China News Service, Guangzhou, November 6 (Guo Jun, Hu Haiyan) The mid-span of the Zhanglong section of the Ruimei-Meijiang Railway Meijiang Bridge, built by the Shenzhen Engineering Construction Headquarters of the Guangzhou Bureau of the State Railway and constructed by the China Railway 15th Bureau Group, was successfully closed on the 5th, marking the completion of the entire Meijiang Bridge and a milestone breakthrough in the key and difficult bridge projects in the bidding section, clearing key obstacles for subsequent girder track laying and line construction. Meijiang Super Large Bridge is a third-line bridge jointly built by Ruimei Railway and Longlong Railway. The starting and ending mileage of the bridge is DK241+228.659~DK242+158.485, the center mileage is DK241+693.555, and the total length of the bridge is 929.826 meters. This time, the continuous beams from piers 16 to 19 in Helong span the Zhanglong Railway at DK242+029.5, with an angle of 68° to the existing railway, and are close to the business line. The construction safety risks are high and the control requirements are strict. In order to minimize the disturbance of the bridge construction to the existing railway operations and ensure the safety of trains on the existing lines, the project department set up special protective scaffolding within the continuous beam operation range to build a strong safety protection barrier for the existing lines.

中新网广西钦州11月15日电 题：平陆运河之畔文脉新生 广西钦江两岸文旅织新。百: China News Service, Qinzhou, Guangxi, November 15th. Title: Cultural context reborn along the Pinglu Canal. Cultural tourism is reborn on both sides of the Qinjiang River in Guangxi. More than a hundred years ago, the master of painting Qi Baishi visited Qinzhou, Guangxi three times, leaving behind a large number of masterpieces with the theme of coastal scenery. He even wrote the famous line "May the wind blow me to Qinzhou", laying a heavy cultural seed in this sea-facing city. Now, with the opening of the Pinglu Canal, this cultural seed that spans a century has sprouted on the banks of the Qinjiang River, and is growing into a cultural tourism sprout with both historical depth and modern vitality. In early winter, Qinzhou City’s Baishi Lake Park is still full of greenery.

中新网成都11月1日电(陈选斌)11月1日，坐落于成都锦江河畔的公益展馆“和平小: China News Service, Chengdu, November 1 (Chen Xuanbin) On November 1, the "Peace House", a charity exhibition hall located on the banks of the Jinjiang River in Chengdu, celebrated its first anniversary. On that day, the exhibition hall publicly displayed for the first time the evidence of Japanese aggression against China collected by Taiwanese compatriots in Japan. This batch of historical materials was entrusted by Taiwanese compatriots to a team of Chinese and French youths to bring them across the Taiwan Strait to the mainland. They will be first displayed at the "Peace Lodge" and will later be transferred to the Memorial Hall of the Victims of the Nanjing Massacre by the Japanese Invaders for identification, collection and preservation. This exhibition hall measuring several dozen square meters was co-founded by French friends Marcus and Bai Shijie and Chinese young man Zhong Haosong. It restores the history of Japan's invasion of China in three dimensions from the perspective of French folk, original Japanese records, and survivor testimonies.
中新网成都11月25日电 (记者 张浪)四川省纪委监委25日消息：日前，经四川省: China News Service, Chengdu, November 25 (Reporter Zhang Lang) News from the Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision on the 25th: Recently, with the approval of the Sichuan Provincial Party Committee, the Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision has launched a case review and investigation into Deng Wenguo, a former member of the party group and deputy mayor of the Guang'an Municipal Government, and the former party secretary and director of the Municipal Public Security Bureau, for serious violations of discipline and law. After investigation, Deng Wenguo, as a leading party member, has lost his ideals and beliefs, has a weak sense of discipline and law, is disloyal and dishonest to the party, attempts to evade scrutiny, and fails to fulfill his responsibility as the main body of comprehensive and strict governance of the party; violates organizational principles, conceals personal matters, and takes advantage of his authority. Seeking benefits for others in terms of job promotion and other aspects and accepting property; accepting gifts for a long time; intervening in law enforcement activities in violation of regulations; failing to cultivate personal ethics; taking advantage of the convenience of the position to seek benefits for others, accepting particularly large amounts of property from others; and refusing to retire. Deng Wenguo seriously violated the Party's political discipline, organizational discipline, integrity discipline, work discipline and life discipline, which constituted a serious job violation and was suspected of accepting bribes and taking advantage of influence to accept bribes. He did not restrain himself or stop after the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China. This is serious in nature and has a bad influence, and should be dealt with seriously. In accordance with the "Disciplinary Punishment Regulations of the Communist Party of China", the Supervision Law of the People's Republic of China, the Government Punishment Law for Public Employees and other relevant provisions, after study by the Standing Committee of the Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and submitted to the Provincial Party Committee for approval, it was decided to expel Deng Wenguo from the party; cancel his benefits in accordance with regulations; confiscate his illegal income; transfer his suspected crimes to the procuratorial organs for review and prosecution in accordance with the law, and transfer the property involved.

Within its borders are seven main routes, including the Ziwu Road and the Baoxie Road, with a total length of approximately 1,300 kilometers. Along these routes, there are a vast number of cliffside inscriptions and ancient village remains, with a high concentration of cultural relics and significant historical value. The Regulation consists of forty-seven articles, which clearly state that the protection of the Shu Roads should adhere to the principles of prioritizing protection, giving precedence to cultural heritage, strengthening management, and ensuring rational use, in order to preserve the authenticity and integrity of the historical form and character of the Shu Roads.

The department is closely monitoring the potential risks to drinking water safety posed by the El Niño phenomenon and is urging the public to pay attention to drinking water and food safety. According to the Philippine Department of Health's epidemiological report, 27 cases of cholera were reported in the Philippines from October 11 to 24, representing a 69% increase from the 16 cases reported in the previous two weeks. He pointed out that the party has led the people to manage the Yellow River for 80 years, which has fundamentally changed the historical situation of "two breaches in three years" and created the miracle of peace and stability every year, fully demonstrating the significant advantages of the socialist system. Xi Jinping emphasized that on the new journey, we must be guided by the Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, firmly grasp the strategic requirements of focusing on protection and governance, adhere to the water control ideas of prioritizing water conservation, spatial balance, systematic governance, and using both hands, and continue to improve large-scale protection. Local ecological and environmental standards, formulated based on local environmental endowments and industrial characteristics, have played an important role in promoting the improvement of regional environmental quality and driving the green upgrading of industries. With the rapid development of local pollutant discharge standards, some new issues have gradually emerged: The development of standards across different regions is uneven. Some provinces with clusters of key industries only implement national standards and lack targeted local standards, making it difficult to meet local environmental improvement requirements. In some regions with a large number of local standards, the standards formulated for different industries, river basins, and pollutants overlap with each other, making them difficult for grassroots law enforcement and enterprises to implement. There is insufficient alignment of standards across provinces, and different regions have varying control requirements for similar emission sources within the same river basin or region. Recently, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment and the State Administration for Market Regulation jointly issued the "Opinions on Effectively Implementing Local Ecological and Environmental Standards." These opinions focus on these prominent issues and propose ten measures from three aspects: system development, quality improvement, and mechanism enhancement.

新华社北京10月31日电(记者王立彬)通过共伴生、低品位、难利用战略性矿产再评价: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, October 31 (Reporter Wang Libin) Through the re-evaluation of co-associated, low-grade, and difficult-to-use strategic minerals, China's rhenium retained resources have more than doubled, gold is equivalent to 50 new large-scale mineral deposits, and nickel is equivalent to 30 new large-scale mineral deposits. Data released by the Ministry of Natural Resources on October 31 shows that in 2024, the Ministry of Natural Resources organized 27 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities, more than 100 units, and nearly 2,000 investigators to carry out a comprehensive investigation. Re-evaluation of associated and low-grade resources of 17 strategic minerals including gallium, germanium, indium, chromite, nickel, cobalt, zirconium, hafnium, niobium, tantalum, vanadium, rare earths, rhenium, potash, gold, manganese and helium. After one year of work, we completed the resource re-evaluation of more than 1,800 active mines and large and medium-sized mining areas across the country, and found out the actual development and utilization of 17 types of strategic mineral co-associated and low-grade resources, as well as the number of co-associated and low-grade resources that can be utilized under current technical and economic conditions. Qiao Chunlei, deputy director of the Mineral Resources Protection and Supervision Department of the Ministry of Natural Resources, said that after investigation and evaluation, the national reserves of 13 minerals such as gallium, germanium and indium have increased significantly. For example, the national reserves of rhenium have more than doubled, gold is equivalent to 50 new large-scale mineral deposits, and nickel This is equivalent to the addition of 30 large-scale mineral deposits, and more than 10 large-scale mineral deposits of gallium, indium, tantalum and vanadium, which strongly supports the successful completion of the new round of mineral prospecting breakthrough strategic action goals of the "14th Five-Year Plan" and lays an important resource foundation for improving the security level of China's mineral resources.
